Work on an ordinary tiddler like on a Streams outline: select a block, edit it in place, move it with Alt-Up/Down, indent it with Tab, and see the result rendered at once. The tiddler stays one tiddler; no helper tiddlers are created.

## Features

- **Toggle per tiddler** - an *outline* button in the view toolbar. Off means the normal view.
- **Same rendering** - the tiddler renders exactly as usual; outline mode only adds data attributes, a selection frame and key handling.
- **Units** - list items, lists, headings (with sections), paragraphs, code blocks, tables, opened HTML containers, transclusion lines, and widgets or macro calls (one opaque unit each).
- **Selection** - click, Up/Down, Escape clears.
- **Move** - Alt-Up/Alt-Down swap a unit with its sibling, subtree included. Moves stay inside the parent.
- **Indent** - Tab/Shift-Tab demote/promote list items and headings with their subtrees.
- **In-place editor** - Shift-Enter opens TW's own edit widget at the unit. Ctrl-Enter saves, Enter saves and starts a new unit, Escape discards.
- **Transclusions** - a marker on `{{...}}` lines; Enter opens the target in outline mode.
- **Safe writes** - every write is a splice of a known range; changed text is relocated or refused, never guessed.

## Prerequisites

- TiddlyWiki 5.4.0 or later (JS modules: server restart or reload needed after install)
- Optional: `rimir/theme`, `rimir/doc-template`

## Quick Start

1. Install the plugin and restart the server.
2. Open a wikitext tiddler and press *outline* in its view toolbar.
3. Click a block; Up/Down select, Alt-Down moves, Tab indents.
4. Shift-Enter edits, Ctrl-Enter saves.

Wikitext only; Markdown is not supported yet. llm-inline `AI:` lines do not fire from outline edits.

<$fill $name="body">

!! Approach

The tiddler is rendered unchanged. A JS widget, `$outline`, wraps the normal body transclusion, walks the rendered widget tree and stamps `data-ol-*` attributes on the DOM node of each unit. One delegated `keydown` and `click` handler lives on the widget's container. Operations are splices of known text ranges. Wrapper elements inside the body are avoided on purpose: they would change the HTML and break CSS such as `ul > li`. The one exception is the widget's own container: while outline mode is on, the whole body sits inside `div.rr-ol`, so selectors such as `.tc-tiddler-body > p` no longer match (use `.tc-tiddler-body p` or also match `.tc-tiddler-body > .rr-ol > p`).

!! Parts

|!File |!Role |
|`model.js` |Collects units from the widget tree: start, end, kind, level, parent, siblings |
|`text-utils.js`, `dom-utils.js` |Pure text helpers; DOM lookup shared by widget and editor |
|`formats.js` |Registry of format adapters |
|`format-wikitext.js` |Wikitext adapter: indent, promote, move, replace, insertNew, remove, editSource, isMultiline |
|`outline-widget.js` |The `$outline` widget: unit-to-DOM mapping, stamps, selection, writes |
|`outline-keys.js` |Key dispatch through `$:/config/shortcuts/outline-*` |
|`outline-editor.js` |In-place editor: temp tiddler, placeholder, save, continue, conflict handling |
|`ui/*` |Toolbar button and icon, body template and its filter, editor template, transclusion marker |
|`styles.tid` |Selection frame, marker |

!! Routing

`ui/toolbar-button` toggles `$:/state/rimir/outline/on/<title>` (`yes`/`no`). `ui/body-filter` (a `$:/tags/ViewTemplateBodyFilter` entry) routes eligible tiddlers with state `yes` to `ui/body`, which renders `<$outline>` around the usual block transclusion.

!! Editor

The editor is a real TW edit widget bound to a temp tiddler (`$:/temp/rimir/outline/...`), placed where the unit was. It lives outside the rendered body's widget tree, so a re-render of the body does not destroy it. Typing changes only the temp tiddler; the real tiddler changes once per save.

A re-render of an ancestor (for example a changed `$:/tags/Global` or `$:/tags/Macro` tiddler re-renders the page template) or closing the tiddler destroys the `$outline` widget. A buffer that differs from what the editor started with is then kept: it carries `outline-orig-source`, `outline-orig-start`, `outline-orig-text`, `outline-is-new` and `outline-unit-kind`, and the next `$outline` widget of the tiddler reopens the editor at the unit, located as on save (or with the conflict notice when the unit is gone). Escape and switching outline mode off discard it.

!! Writes

A single `wiki.addTiddler` of the old tiddler plus the new `text` and modification fields. Before writing, the text must equal the text the positions were computed from, otherwise the view re-renders first. If the text is this view's own last write (a key pressed before the refresh after a write), the operation goes on on the rebuilt mapping; after any other change nothing is written.

Structural operations pass a model guard (`checkOp` in `model.js`) before they are written: the result is parsed again, and a move must keep the unit count and the kinds and levels; indent/promote must keep the unit count and change only the operated subtree's levels, by exactly one. Anything else is refused without a write. Structural keys do nothing while the view has an open editor.

</$fill>
</$transclude>

!! Tests

```
bin/tw test outline        # Jasmine, all outline specs
bin/tw test                # the whole suite
```

Specs live in `test/`: `test-parser-pins.js` (parser positions), `test-model.js`, `test-text-utils.js`, `test-indent.js`, `test-move.js`, `test-edit.js`, `test-editor.js`, `test-keys.js`, `test-widget.js`, with shared fixtures in `fixtures.js`.

!! Invariants

Every operation test uses one shared assertion: only the unit's range (and the swapped sibling's) changes, a no-op returns the identical string, and an operation followed by its inverse restores the text exactly.

!! Adding a format

A format adapter registers in `formats.js` and provides `indent`, `promote`, `move`, `replace`, `insertNew`, `remove`, `editSource` and `isMultiline` for one content type. Markdown is planned as the second adapter.

!! Restart

All JS modules (`module-type: widget` and library modules) need a server restart or reload. Templates and settings tiddlers do not.

</$fill>

!! Moving and indenting

Take this note:

```
! Shopping
* milk
* bread
** rye
* eggs
```

Select //bread//, press Alt-Down: `bread` and `rye` swap places with `eggs`. Press Tab on //eggs//: it becomes `** eggs` under `bread`. Press Shift-Tab to undo.

!! Save and new

Select a list item, Shift-Enter, type, press Enter: the item is saved and a new item with the same marker opens after the item's whole subtree. Leave it empty and press Ctrl-Enter or Escape: nothing is written.

!! Transclusions

A line `{{Other note}}` shows a small marker. Select it and press Enter: //Other note// opens in the story with outline mode on.

<$fill $name="body">

!! Which tiddlers can be outlined?

Wikitext tiddlers (`text/vnd.tiddlywiki`) that are not drafts, system tiddlers, `code-body` or `hide-body` tiddlers. v1 is wikitext only; Markdown comes later through a second format adapter.

!! Where does the button show?

In the view toolbar, per tiddler. State is `$:/state/rimir/outline/on/<title>`.

!! Can I move a unit into another list or section?

Not yet. Moves stay inside the parent: at the first or last child, Alt-Up/Down do nothing. Moving across parents is a planned follow-up.

!! Are widgets and macros editable inside?

No. `<$list>`, `<$reveal>`, macro and procedure calls are single units: select, move or edit their source as a whole. Only plain HTML containers are opened.

!! Why can't I select a block?

Units that render nothing (for example a procedure call with empty output) have no DOM node and cannot be selected.

!! What happens when I save an empty unit?

A unit without children is deleted. A unit with children is not: the save is refused with a notice. A new unit (from Enter) that stays empty writes nothing.

!! What if the tiddler changes while I edit?

Your text is kept. On save the unit is looked up again by its original source: if it occurs exactly once, the save goes there; otherwise the editor stays open with a notice.

!! Two views of the same tiddler?

Only one view can edit at a time.

!! What happens to an unsaved edit?

Escape or toggling outline mode off discards it. If you changed the text and the view is rendered again (for example after a global macro changed) or you close the tiddler, the text is kept: the editor opens again at the unit as soon as the tiddler is shown in outline mode. If the unit is gone by then, the editor opens with the "changed underneath" notice, so you can copy your text. Kept text lives in a `$:/temp/` tiddler and is gone after a reload.

!! Why does Alt-Up/Down add a blank line?

When a list, code block or table is followed directly (single line break) by a paragraph, swapping them as they are would merge the paragraph with its new neighbour. Such blocks get a blank line between them. Items and headings keep their line breaks.

A comment (or other text that is not a unit) between the two blocks is kept and set apart by blank lines too.

!! Why does Alt-Up/Down sometimes do nothing?

A move only swaps a unit with its neighbour inside the same parent, and only with a neighbour of the same class (heading with heading of the same level, item with item of the same level, other blocks with other blocks). Before writing, outline re-parses the result; if the swap would change the units (for example a heading section whose last paragraph would merge with the next block), the move is refused and the text stays unchanged. Add a blank line between the blocks by hand and try again.

!! Why do Tab and Alt-Up/Down do nothing while I edit?

Structural keys are blocked while the view has an open editor: a move could rewrite the unit you are editing. Save or cancel first.

!! My CSS for `.tc-tiddler-body > p` stopped working

While outline mode is on, the body is wrapped in `div.rr-ol`, so child selectors of `.tc-tiddler-body` no longer match. Use a descendant selector (`.tc-tiddler-body p`) or also match `.tc-tiddler-body > .rr-ol > p`.

!! Do `AI:` lines of llm-inline fire?

No. Outline writes bypass `th-saving-tiddler`, which llm-inline listens to. `AI:` lines typed in outline mode do not fire; they do after a normal editor save.

!! Do editor plugins work?

Yes, the editor is TW's own edit widget. AutoComplete handles Enter, Escape, Tab and the arrows first; outline keys act only if the event was not consumed.

!! Does Tab leave the page?

No, while a unit is selected Tab is used for indent.

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<$fill $name="body">

!! What it does

Outline mode brings the Streams workflow to a normal tiddler. Switch it on for a tiddler with the //outline// button in the view toolbar. The tiddler renders as before; every block that comes from its own text becomes selectable. Select a block, edit it in place, move it, indent it. Each action rewrites the right part of that one tiddler's text.

!! How you use it

# Press //outline// in the view toolbar (the button is shown for wikitext tiddlers only, not for drafts, system tiddlers, `code-body` or `hide-body` tiddlers).
# Click a block or press Up/Down. A blue frame marks the selected unit.
# Alt-Up/Alt-Down move it, Tab/Shift-Tab indent or promote it. Its subtree goes along.
# Shift-Enter opens the editor in place. Ctrl-Enter saves, Enter saves and opens a new unit, Escape discards.
# On a transclusion line, Enter opens the target tiddler, already in outline mode.

!! Units

* List items (`*`, `#`, `;`, `:`, `>`) - the item's own lines; nested items are its subtree.
* Lists as a whole.
* Headings, with their section (up to the next heading of the same or a higher level) as subtree.
* Paragraphs, code blocks, tables.
* Plain HTML containers (`<div>`, `<section>`, ...) are opened: their inner blocks are units, and the container is one too.
* Transclusion lines (`{{...}}`, `<$transclude/>`).
* Widgets (`<$list>`, `<$reveal>`, ...) and macro or procedure calls: opaque, one unit each.

Pragmas (`\define`, `\procedure`, `\import`, ...) are never units. A unit that renders nothing cannot be selected.

!! Read-only wikis

With `$:/status/IsReadOnly` = yes, only navigation (selection, transclusion jump) works.

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<$fill $name="body">

!! Keys

|!Shortcut tiddler |!Default |!Action |
|`outline-up` / `outline-down` |Up / Down |Select previous / next unit |
|`outline-move-up` / `outline-move-down` |alt-Up / alt-Down |Swap with previous / next sibling |
|`outline-indent` / `outline-promote` |Tab / shift-Tab |Demote / promote by one level |
|`outline-edit` |shift-Enter |Edit in place |
|`outline-open` |Enter |Open the transclusion target in outline mode |
|`outline-clear` |Escape |Clear selection |
|`outline-save` |ctrl-Enter |Save the edit |
|`outline-continue` |Enter |Save and open a new unit (single-line units) |
|`outline-newline` |shift-Enter |Newline in the editor |
|`outline-cancel` |Escape |Discard the edit |

All are `$:/config/shortcuts/<name>`; descriptions are in `$:/config/ShortcutInfo/<name>`.

In multi-line units (code blocks, tables, widgets, `"""` items) Enter is a plain newline and only Ctrl-Enter saves.

!! Indent and promote

* Lists: a list item and its subtree lines get one more of the item's last marker character (`#b` becomes `##b`, `*b` `**b`, `#*` `#**`). No previous sibling: no-op. Promote removes one marker character; depth 1 is a no-op.
* Headings: one `!` more on the heading and every heading in its section; no-op if one would pass 6. Promote removes one; level 1 is a no-op.
* Other units: Tab and Shift-Tab do nothing.

!! Move

Swap the unit's whole subtree with the adjacent sibling's whole subtree, blank-line separators preserved. Blocks other than items and headings that touch (a single line break) get a blank line between them and before the following content, so a paragraph cannot absorb its neighbour. First/last child: no-op.

* List item: siblings are items of the same list at the same depth.
* Heading: siblings are headings of the same level in the same parent.
* Other blocks: siblings are blocks in the same section (or HTML container, or root) before any sub-heading.

!! New unit (Enter)

* List item: same marker, after the item's whole subtree.
* Heading: paragraph directly under the heading line.
* Paragraph: paragraph after it.

!! State and config

|!Tiddler |!Purpose |
|`$:/state/rimir/outline/on/<title>` |Outline mode on (`yes`) / off |
|`$:/temp/rimir/outline/...` |Editor buffer and selection while active |

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<$fill $name="body">

!! Parser positions

The plugin relies on the wikitext parser's source offsets. `WikiParser.parseBlock` sets `start`, `end` and `rule` on every top-level block node. The list rule sets them on each list item: from the marker to the end of the item's own line, nested child lines excluded. Every widget keeps its parse node as `widget.parseTreeNode`, so a widget tree walk recovers the ranges.

Units are recomputed after every render and are valid only for the text they were computed from.

!! `{{X}}` is a "tiddler" node

A block transclusion `{{X}}` parses to a node of type `tiddler`, not `transclude`; the walker maps it to the transclusion unit. Widgets rendered from a transcluded tiddler carry offsets into //that// tiddler's text, so descent stops at a transclude to another tiddler.

!! Widget mapping rule

A unit's DOM node is found by matching the parse node's `start` and tag; `end` is the tie-breaker when several widgets share a start (for example a list and its first item).

!! Pragmas and typed blocks

A pragma such as `\define` parses to a `set` node that wraps the rest of the tree; the walker steps through it, and the pragma itself is never a unit. For `$$$` typed blocks the parser starts the node at the line after the `$$$` header, so the widget match uses that line as the unit's anchor instead of the unit start (see `outline-widget.js`).

!! Pin tests

`test/test-parser-pins.js` pins the offsets for list items, a heading and a paragraph, a block transclusion (`{{X}}` parses to a `tiddler` node), pragma wrapping (`\define` yields a `set` node that wraps the following blocks), a code block, a table and a block-mode HTML container. Widgets are not pinned. A TW update that changes them fails the suite loudly.

!! Why writes bypass `th-saving-tiddler`

A write is `wiki.addTiddler` of the old tiddler with new `text` plus `getModificationFields()`. It is not an editor save, and a single splice per action must not trigger editor-save hooks. Consequence: listeners on `th-saving-tiddler`, such as llm-inline's `AI:` lines, do not fire.

!! Editor and AutoComplete

AutoComplete listens on `document` in the capture phase, so its handler runs before the outline key handler, which checks `event.defaultPrevented`.

</$fill>
</$transclude>

title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/dom-utils.js
type: application/javascript
module-type: library

DOM helpers shared by outline-keys.js and outline-editor.js. They work on the browser DOM and on
TW's fake DOM (no nextSibling/contains there; removeChild keeps parentNode).

\*/
"use strict";

exports.setClass = function(node, cls, on) {
	var list = (node.className || "").split(" ").filter(function(c) { return c && c !== cls; });
	if(on) {
		list.push(cls);
	}
	if(list.length) {
		node.className = list.join(" ");
	} else if(node.removeAttribute) {
		node.removeAttribute("class");
	}
};

exports.focus = function(node) {
	if(node && node.focus) {
		node.focus({preventScroll: true});
	}
};

exports.scrollIntoView = function(node) {
	if(node && node.scrollIntoView) {
		node.scrollIntoView({block: "nearest"});
	}
};

// True for input/textarea/select and contenteditable elements and their descendants
exports.isEditable = function(node) {
	for(; node && node.nodeType === 1; node = node.parentNode) {
		var tag = (node.tagName || "").toLowerCase();
		if(tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || tag === "select" || node.isContentEditable) {
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
};

exports.nextSiblingOf = function(node) {
	if(node.nextSibling !== undefined) {
		return node.nextSibling;
	}
	var siblings = node.parentNode ? node.parentNode.childNodes : [],
		i = siblings.indexOf(node);
	return i === -1 ? null : (siblings[i + 1] || null);
};

exports.firstChildOf = function(node) {
	return node.firstChild || null;
};

// True when `node` is attached below (or is) `ancestor`
exports.isInside = function(node, ancestor) {
	if(!node || !ancestor) {
		return false;
	}
	if(ancestor.contains) {
		return ancestor.contains(node);
	}
	while(node && node !== ancestor) {
		var parent = node.parentNode;
		if(!parent || parent.childNodes.indexOf(node) === -1) {
			return false;
		}
		node = parent;
	}
	return node === ancestor;
};

title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/format-wikitext.js
type: application/javascript
module-type: outline-format

Wikitext adapter: indent, promote, move, replace, insertNew, remove. Functions take (text, model, id) and return null or {text, select}.

\*/
"use strict";

var utils = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/text-utils.js");

exports.types = ["text/vnd.tiddlywiki", ""];

// A separator that contains an empty line
var BLANK_LINE = /\n[ \t]*\r?\n/;

// Units of `kind` whose start lies in the subtree of u (u included)
function subtreeUnits(model, u, kind) {
	return model.units.filter(function(d) {
		return d.kind === kind && d.start >= u.start && d.start < u.subtreeEnd;
	});
}

// positions: [{pos, insert}] / removals; applied from the end backwards
function apply(text, edits) {
	edits.sort(function(a, b) { return b.pos - a.pos; });
	edits.forEach(function(e) {
		text = utils.splice(text, e.pos, e.pos + e.remove, e.insert);
	});
	return text;
}

function selectFor(u, edits) {
	// units start never moves: edits at u.start insert before it only for headings, where start stays
	return u.start;
}

exports.indent = function(text, model, id) {
	var u = model.units[id], edits;
	if(!u) { return null; }
	if(u.kind === "item") {
		var sibs = u.parent === -1 ? model.roots : model.units[u.parent].children,
			i = sibs.indexOf(id);
		if(i < 1 || model.units[sibs[i - 1]].kind !== "item") { return null; }
		var c = u.marker.charAt(u.level - 1);
		edits = subtreeUnits(model, u, "item").map(function(d) {
			return {pos: d.start + u.level, remove: 0, insert: c};
		});
	} else if(u.kind === "heading") {
		var hs = subtreeUnits(model, u, "heading");
		if(hs.some(function(h) { return h.level >= 6; })) { return null; }
		edits = hs.map(function(h) { return {pos: h.start, remove: 0, insert: "!"}; });
	} else {
		return null;
	}
	return {text: apply(text, edits), select: selectFor(u, edits)};
};

exports.promote = function(text, model, id) {
	var u = model.units[id], edits;
	if(!u) { return null; }
	if(u.kind === "item") {
		if(u.level <= 1) { return null; }
		edits = subtreeUnits(model, u, "item").map(function(d) {
			return {pos: d.start + u.level - 1, remove: 1, insert: ""};
		});
	} else if(u.kind === "heading") {
		if(u.level <= 1) { return null; }
		edits = subtreeUnits(model, u, "heading").map(function(h) {
			return {pos: h.start, remove: 1, insert: ""};
		});
	} else {
		return null;
	}
	return {text: apply(text, edits), select: selectFor(u, edits)};
};

/*
Swap the unit's whole subtree with the adjacent sibling of the same class (heading vs non-heading).
Items and headings keep the separators as they are. Other blocks that touch (single line break) get a blank line
between them and before the content after the pair, because after the swap a paragraph would otherwise absorb the
block after it. Non-whitespace between the blocks (a comment) is kept and set apart by blank lines.
*/
exports.move = function(text, model, id, dir) {
	var u = model.units[id];
	if(!u || (dir !== -1 && dir !== 1)) { return null; }
	var sibs = u.parent === -1 ? model.roots : model.units[u.parent].children,
		i = sibs.indexOf(id), n = sibs[i + dir];
	if(i < 0 || n === undefined) { return null; }
	var o = model.units[n];
	if((o.kind === "heading") !== (u.kind === "heading")) { return null; }
	if((u.kind === "heading" || u.kind === "item") && (o.kind !== u.kind || o.level !== u.level)) { return null; }
	var a = dir < 0 ? o : u, b = dir < 0 ? u : o,
		A = text.substring(a.start, a.subtreeEnd),
		sep = text.substring(a.subtreeEnd, b.start),
		B = text.substring(b.start, b.subtreeEnd),
		rest = text.substring(b.subtreeEnd);
	if(u.kind !== "item" && u.kind !== "heading") {
		var nl = utils.eol(text),
			gap = /^(?:[ \t]*\r?\n)*/.exec(rest)[0];
		if(/\S/.test(sep)) {
			// Keep anything between the blocks (e.g. a comment), set apart by blank lines on both sides
			sep = nl + nl + sep.trim() + nl + nl;
		} else if(!BLANK_LINE.test(sep)) {
			sep = nl + nl;
		}
		// Only whole line breaks are normalised, so the next line keeps its indentation
		if(/\S/.test(rest) && !BLANK_LINE.test(gap)) {
			rest = nl + nl + rest.substring(gap.length);
		}
	}
	return {
		text: text.substring(0, a.start) + B + sep + A + rest,
		select: dir < 0 ? a.start : a.start + B.length + sep.length
	};
};

// Replace the unit's own source with newSource
exports.replace = function(text, model, id, newSource) {
	var u = model.units[id];
	if(!u) { return null; }
	return {text: utils.splice(text, u.start, u.end, newSource), select: u.start};
};

/*
Insert a new sibling unit (item) or first block (heading/block); null for blank source. A new item's text that
starts with the item's own marker and a space (typed out of habit) loses that marker: it is added anyway.
*/
exports.insertNew = function(text, model, id, newSource) {
	var u = model.units[id];
	if(u && u.kind === "item" && newSource && newSource.substring(0, u.marker.length) === u.marker &&
		/^[ \t]/.test(newSource.substring(u.marker.length))) {
		newSource = newSource.substring(u.marker.length).replace(/^[ \t]+/, "");
	}
	if(!u || !newSource || !newSource.trim()) { return null; }
	var nl = utils.eol(text), pos, insert, select;
	if(u.kind === "item") {
		pos = u.subtreeEnd;
		insert = nl + u.marker + " " + newSource;
		select = pos + nl.length;
	} else {
		pos = u.end;
		insert = nl + nl + newSource;
		select = pos + 2 * nl.length;
		var rest = text.substring(pos);
		if(/\S/.test(rest) && !/^\r?\n[ \t]*\r?\n/.test(rest)) { insert += nl; }
	}
	return {text: utils.splice(text, pos, pos, insert), select: select};
};

/*
Delete a unit without children (blank save in the editor); null for units with children.
Items that have siblings lose their own range plus one adjacent line break. Other units (and an only
item) also lose the blank lines after them, so exactly one separator stays between the neighbours;
the last unit takes the line breaks before it instead.
*/
exports.remove = function(text, model, id) {
	var u = model.units[id];
	if(!u || u.children.length) { return null; }
	var a = u.start, b = u.end,
		after = text.substring(b),
		parent = u.parent === -1 ? null : model.units[u.parent],
		m;
	if(u.kind === "item" && parent && parent.children.length > 1) {
		m = /^\r?\n/.exec(after);
		if(m && /\S/.test(after.substring(m[0].length))) {
			b += m[0].length;
		} else {
			m = /\r?\n$/.exec(text.substring(0, a));
			a -= m ? m[0].length : 0;
		}
	} else {
		m = /^(?:[ \t]*\r?\n)*/.exec(after);
		if(/\S/.test(after.substring(m[0].length))) {
			b += m[0].length;
		} else {
			m = /(?:\r?\n[ \t]*)*$/.exec(text.substring(0, a));
			a -= m[0].length;
		}
	}
	var result = utils.splice(text, a, b, "");
	return {text: result, select: Math.min(a, result.length)};
};

// What the editor shows
exports.editSource = function(text, model, id) {
	var u = model.units[id];
	return u ? text.substring(u.start, u.end) : "";
};

// True when Enter must be a plain newline in the editor
exports.isMultiline = function(model, id) {
	var u = model.units[id];
	if(!u) { return false; }
	if(u.tag === "codeblock" || u.tag === "table" || u.kind === "widget" || u.kind === "container") { return true; }
	return /[\r\n]/.test(model.text.substring(u.start, u.end));
};

title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js
type: application/javascript
module-type: library

Builds the outline unit model of a wikitext text from TiddlyWiki's parse tree.

buildModel(wiki, text, title) -> {text, units, roots}
Each unit: {id, kind, start, end, subtreeEnd, level, marker, parent, children, tag, target}.
`title` (optional) is the tiddler the text belongs to: a transclusion of it is a widget, not a transclusion.

\*/
"use strict";

// Pragma rules: their nodes wrap the rest of the tree and are never units
var PRAGMA_RULES = {
	macrodef: true, procedure: true, fnprocdef: true, "function": true, import: true,
	importvariables: true, whitespace: true, rules: true, parameters: true, set: true
};
var LIST_TAGS = {ul: true, ol: true, dl: true, blockquote: true};
var ITEM_TAGS = {li: true, dt: true, dd: true, div: true};
var HEADING_RE = /^h([1-6])$/;
var MARKER_CHARS = "*#;:>";

function literal(node, name) {
	var attr = node.attributes && node.attributes[name];
	return attr && attr.type === "string" ? attr.value : null;
}

exports.buildModel = function(wiki, text, title) {
	text = text || "";
	var units = [], roots = [];

	// Own range end without trailing line breaks (some rules include the newline)
	function trimEnd(start, end) {
		end = Math.min(end, text.length);
		while(end > start && (text.charAt(end - 1) === "\n" || text.charAt(end - 1) === "\r")) {
			end--;
		}
		return end;
	}

	function addUnit(node, kind, parent, extra) {
		var start = node.start,
			end = trimEnd(start, node.end),
			unit = {
				id: units.length,
				kind: kind,
				start: start,
				end: end,
				subtreeEnd: end,
				level: 0,
				marker: "",
				parent: parent,
				children: [],
				tag: node.type === "element" ? node.tag : node.type,
				target: null
			};
		$tw.utils.extend(unit, extra || {});
		units.push(unit);
		if(parent === -1) {
			roots.push(unit.id);
		} else {
			units[parent].children.push(unit.id);
		}
		return unit;
	}

	// Widen subtreeEnd of a unit and its ancestors
	function extend(unit, end) {
		while(unit && unit.subtreeEnd < end) {
			unit.subtreeEnd = end;
			unit = unit.parent === -1 ? null : units[unit.parent];
		}
	}

	function hasPosition(node) {
		return typeof node.start === "number" && typeof node.end === "number";
	}

	// Items of a list node (ul/ol/dl/blockquote), as children of `parent`
	function walkItems(listNode, parent) {
		$tw.utils.each(listNode.children || [], function(itemNode) {
			if(itemNode.type !== "element" || !ITEM_TAGS[itemNode.tag] || !hasPosition(itemNode)) {
				return;
			}
			var children = itemNode.children || [],
				first = children[0];
			// Skipped levels ("* a\n*** c") produce a synthetic item that only holds the deeper list
			// and starts where it starts: it is not a unit, its items go to `parent`
			if(first && first.type === "element" && LIST_TAGS[first.tag] && first.start === itemNode.start) {
				$tw.utils.each(children, function(child) {
					if(isNestedList(child)) {
						walkItems(child, parent);
					}
				});
				return;
			}
			var pos = itemNode.start;
			while(pos < text.length && MARKER_CHARS.indexOf(text.charAt(pos)) !== -1) {
				pos++;
			}
			var marker = text.substring(itemNode.start, pos),
				item = addUnit(itemNode, "item", parent, {level: marker.length, marker: marker});
			extend(units[parent], item.end);
			$tw.utils.each(children, function(child) {
				if(isNestedList(child)) {
					walkItems(child, item.id);
				}
			});
		});
	}

	function isNestedList(node) {
		return node.type === "element" && LIST_TAGS[node.tag] && node.rule === undefined;
	}

	// Block-level nodes of one container (root or opened HTML element).
	// `ctx` = {parent: container unit id or -1, headings: stack of open heading units}
	function walkBlocks(nodes, ctx) {
		$tw.utils.each(nodes || [], function(node) {
			walkBlock(node, ctx);
		});
	}

	function currentParent(ctx) {
		return ctx.headings.length ? ctx.headings[ctx.headings.length - 1].id : ctx.parent;
	}

	function walkBlock(node, ctx) {
		if(node.rule && PRAGMA_RULES[node.rule]) {
			walkBlocks(node.children, ctx);
			return;
		}
		if(!hasPosition(node)) {
			// Unpositioned wrapper: step through
			if(node.type !== "text") {
				walkBlocks(node.children, ctx);
			}
			return;
		}
		if(node.type === "text") {
			return;
		}
		if(node.rule === "commentblock") {
			// Comments render nothing. At the top of the text (pragma position) they wrap the rest
			walkBlocks(node.children, ctx);
			return;
		}
		var unit, m;
		if(node.type === "element" && (m = HEADING_RE.exec(node.tag)) && node.rule === "heading") {
			var level = parseInt(m[1], 10);
			while(ctx.headings.length && ctx.headings[ctx.headings.length - 1].level >= level) {
				ctx.headings.pop();
			}
			unit = addUnit(node, "heading", currentParent(ctx), {level: level});
			ctx.headings.push(unit);
			extendParent(unit);
			return;
		}
		var parent = currentParent(ctx);
		if(node.type === "element" && node.rule === "list" && LIST_TAGS[node.tag]) {
			unit = addUnit(node, "list", parent);
			extendParent(unit);
			walkItems(node, unit.id);
			// The list node ends at its last top-level item, without that item's nested items:
			// the list's own range is its full extent
			unit.end = unit.subtreeEnd;
			extendParent(unit);
			return;
		}
		if(node.type === "element" && node.isBlock && node.rule === "html") {
			unit = addUnit(node, "container", parent);
			var before = units.length;
			walkBlocks(node.children, {parent: unit.id, headings: []});
			if(units.length === before) {
				unit.kind = "block";
			}
			extendParent(unit);
			return;
		}
		if(node.type === "element" || node.type === "codeblock" || node.type === "void") {
			if(node.rule === "typedblock") {
				// The typedblock rule starts the node after its "$$$type" header line
				var lineStart = text.lastIndexOf("\n", node.start - 2) + 1;
				if(text.substr(lineStart, 3) === "$$$") {
					node = $tw.utils.extend({}, node, {start: lineStart});
				}
			}
			unit = addUnit(node, "block", parent);
			extendParent(unit);
			return;
		}
		var target = null;
		if(node.type === "tiddler" && node.rule === "transcludeblock") {
			target = literal(node, "tiddler");
		} else if(node.type === "transclude" && !(node.attributes && node.attributes.$variable)) {
			target = literal(node, "$tiddler");
			if(target === null && !(node.attributes && node.attributes.$tiddler)) {
				target = literal(node, "tiddler");
			}
		}
		if(target && target !== title) {
			unit = addUnit(node, "transclusion", parent, {target: target});
		} else {
			unit = addUnit(node, "widget", parent);
		}
		extendParent(unit);
	}

	function extendParent(unit) {
		if(unit.parent !== -1) {
			extend(units[unit.parent], unit.subtreeEnd);
		}
	}

	var tree = wiki.parseText("text/vnd.tiddlywiki", text).tree;
	walkBlocks(tree, {parent: -1, headings: []});
	return {text: text, units: units, roots: roots};
};

/*
Id of the unit that starts at `start`, preferring `kind` (a list and its first item share a start);
-1 if none. accept(id) optionally restricts the candidates (e.g. to units with DOM nodes).
*/
exports.findUnit = function(model, start, kind, accept) {
	var match = -1;
	for(var i = 0; i < model.units.length; i++) {
		var u = model.units[i];
		if(u.start === start && (!accept || accept(u.id))) {
			if(!kind || u.kind === kind) {
				return u.id;
			}
			if(match === -1) {
				match = u.id;
			}
		}
	}
	return match;
};

/*
Post-operation guard: true when `newText` has the units a structural operation `name` on unit `id` of model
`before` must leave. Moves keep the unit count and the kinds and levels (as a multiset: the order changes).
Indent/promote keep the unit count and order; the units of the operated subtree (of the unit's kind) change
their level by exactly +1/-1, all others keep it. Anything else is refused by the caller (no write).
*/
exports.checkOp = function(wiki, before, id, name, newText, title) {
	var after = exports.buildModel(wiki, newText, title),
		u = before.units[id];
	if(!u || after.units.length !== before.units.length) {
		return false;
	}
	function signature(m) {
		return m.units.map(function(x) { return x.kind + ":" + x.level; }).sort().join(",");
	}
	if(name === "move") {
		return signature(after) === signature(before);
	}
	if(name !== "indent" && name !== "promote") {
		return false;
	}
	var delta = name === "indent" ? 1 : -1;
	for(var i = 0; i < before.units.length; i++) {
		var a = before.units[i], b = after.units[i],
			affected = a.kind === u.kind && a.start >= u.start && a.start < u.subtreeEnd;
		if(a.kind !== b.kind || b.level !== a.level + (affected ? delta : 0)) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
};

title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/outline-editor.js
type: application/javascript
module-type: library

In-place editor of the $outline widget. install(proto) adds these methods to the widget prototype:
  startEdit(id, {isNew})       - open the editor for unit `id` (isNew: for a new unit after unit `id`)
  saveEdit({continue})         - write the edit once; continue: open a new unit after the saved one
  cancelEdit()                 - discard the edit
  insertNewline()              - insert a line break at the caret through the engine
  reattachEditor()             - after a re-render: put the host next to the relocated unit, or reopen a kept edit
  releaseEditor()              - on destroy: close the editor, keep a changed buffer for the next widget
  handleEditorKeydown(event)   - keys while editing (events from inside the host)
  openTarget(title)            - open a transcluded tiddler in outline mode

this.editor = {host, widget, id, isNew, kind, unitKind, placement, origSource, origStart, origText, multiline,
               notice, caret, focused, hidden}
  host       - <div> (or <li> for a new item), class rr-ol-editor-host. Not part of the body's widget tree, so
               a re-render of the body does not destroy it.
  placement  - "inside": first child of the edited item's element (its sub-items stay visible);
               "before": before the edited unit's first DOM node; "after": after the anchor of a new unit
  widget     - the editor widget tree ($:/plugins/rimir/outline/ui/editor), parent: the outline widget
  id         - unit id in the current mapping (the edited unit, or the anchor of a new unit), -1: not found
  origSource - own source of the unit (anchor) when the edit started; relocates it after outside changes
  origText   - tiddler text when the edit started

Buffer: $:/temp/rimir/outline/edit/<title>, one per tiddler. Typing only changes the buffer; the tiddler is
written once on save. When the same tiddler is shown twice, the view that opened the editor owns the buffer
(module registry `owners`): other views cannot open a second editor and never touch the buffer.
The buffer also carries what is needed to reopen the edit: fields outline-orig-source, outline-orig-start,
outline-orig-text, outline-is-new (yes/no) and outline-unit-kind (for a new unit: those of its anchor).

Kept edits: when the widget is destroyed (an ancestor re-rendered, the tiddler was closed) and the buffer differs
from what the editor started with, the buffer is kept, not discarded. The next $outline widget of that tiddler
that maps its units and finds such a buffer without a live owner reopens the editor at the unit (located as on
save: unchanged text -> the same unit, otherwise the one unit with the same own source and kind); if the unit is
gone it opens with the conflict notice, so the text stays visible. Escape and the toolbar toggle-off discard it.

\*/
"use strict";

var formats = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/formats.js"),
	utils = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/text-utils.js"),
	model = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js"),
	dom = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/dom-utils.js");

var BUFFER_PREFIX = "$:/temp/rimir/outline/edit/",
	STATE_PREFIX = "$:/state/rimir/outline/on/",
	EDITOR_TIDDLER = "$:/plugins/rimir/outline/ui/editor",
	HOST_CLASS = "rr-ol-editor-host",
	// Edited unit hidden (blocks) / only its own content hidden (items: sub-items stay visible)
	EDITING_CLASS = "rr-ol-editing",
	EDITING_OWN_CLASS = "rr-ol-editing-own",
	NOTICES = {
		conflict: {cls: "rr-ol-notice rr-ol-conflict", text: "The tiddler changed underneath. Copy your text."},
		children: {cls: "rr-ol-notice rr-ol-children", text: "Remove or move its children first."},
		readonly: {cls: "rr-ol-notice rr-ol-readonly", text: "The wiki is read-only."}
	};

// Per wiki: buffer title -> outline widget that owns the open editor for it
var registries = new WeakMap(),
	// Per wiki: buffer title -> {focused, caret} of an editor whose widget was destroyed with a kept buffer
	restoreHints = new WeakMap();

function registryOf(map, wiki) {
	var registry = map.get(wiki);
	if(!registry) {
		registry = Object.create(null);
		map.set(wiki, registry);
	}
	return registry;
}

function ownersOf(wiki) {
	return registryOf(registries, wiki);
}

// Editor state for unit kind `unitKind` (for a new unit: the anchor's kind); id and multiline are set by the caller
function editorState(unitKind, isNew, origSource, origStart, origText) {
	return {
		host: null,
		widget: null,
		id: -1,
		isNew: isNew,
		kind: isNew ? (unitKind === "item" ? "item" : "block") : unitKind,
		unitKind: unitKind,
		placement: isNew ? "after" : (unitKind === "item" ? "inside" : "before"),
		origSource: origSource,
		origStart: origStart,
		origText: origText,
		multiline: false,
		notice: null,
		caret: null,
		focused: false,
		hidden: []
	};
}

var methods = {};

methods.bufferTitle = function() {
	return BUFFER_PREFIX + this.tiddlerTitle;
};

methods.ownsBuffer = function() {
	return ownersOf(this.wiki)[this.bufferTitle()] === this;
};

// The other view that has a live editor for this tiddler, or null
methods.otherOwner = function() {
	var owner = ownersOf(this.wiki)[this.bufferTitle()];
	if(!owner || owner === this || !owner.editor || owner.domNode.isConnected === false) {
		return null;
	}
	return owner;
};

/*
Open the editor. Nothing is written until it is saved. Returns false when nothing was opened (also when
another view of the same tiddler has an open editor: that one gets the focus instead).
*/
methods.startEdit = function(id, opts) {
	opts = opts || {};
	if(this.editor) {
		this.focusEditor();
		return false;
	}
	var owner = this.otherOwner();
	if(owner) {
		owner.focusEditor();
		return false;
	}
	if(this.isReadOnly() || !this.getAdapter()) {
		return false;
	}
	if(this.wiki.getTiddlerText(this.tiddlerTitle, "") !== this.model.text) {
		// A change has not been rendered yet: positions are stale. After this view's own write the selection is
		// restored from the saved one, so an edit of the selected unit can go on; otherwise do nothing
		var fromSelection = id === this.selectedId;
		if(!this.ensureCurrent() || !fromSelection) {
			return false;
		}
		id = this.selectedId;
	}
	if(!this.isSelectable(id)) {
		return false;
	}
	var unit = this.units[id].unit,
		isNew = !!opts.isNew,
		adapter = this.getAdapter(),
		ed = editorState(unit.kind, isNew, this.model.text.substring(unit.start, unit.end), unit.start, this.model.text);
	ed.id = id;
	ed.multiline = !isNew && adapter.isMultiline(this.model, id);
	this.editor = ed;
	ownersOf(this.wiki)[this.bufferTitle()] = this;
	this.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({
		title: this.bufferTitle(),
		text: isNew ? "" : adapter.editSource(this.model.text, this.model, id),
		type: "text/vnd.tiddlywiki",
		"outline-orig-source": ed.origSource,
		"outline-orig-start": String(ed.origStart),
		"outline-orig-text": ed.origText,
		"outline-is-new": isNew ? "yes" : "no",
		"outline-unit-kind": ed.unitKind
	}));
	this.placeEditor(true);
	return true;
};

/*
Reopen a kept edit (see "Kept edits" above). Returns true when an editor was opened. Not while another live view
owns the editor, in read-only wikis, or for tiddlers without an adapter.
*/
methods.restoreEditor = function() {
	var title = this.bufferTitle(),
		buffer = this.wiki.getTiddler(title);
	if(this.editor || !buffer || buffer.fields["outline-orig-start"] === undefined || this.otherOwner() ||
		this.isReadOnly() || !this.getAdapter()) {
		return false;
	}
	var f = buffer.fields,
		hints = registryOf(restoreHints, this.wiki),
		hint = hints[title] || {},
		ed = editorState(f["outline-unit-kind"] || "", f["outline-is-new"] === "yes", f["outline-orig-source"] || "",
			parseInt(f["outline-orig-start"], 10), f["outline-orig-text"] || "");
	delete hints[title];
	this.editor = ed;
	ownersOf(this.wiki)[title] = this;
	var target = this.locateEditUnit(this.model.text);
	ed.id = target && this.isSelectable(target.id) ? target.id : -1;
	if(ed.id === -1) {
		ed.notice = "conflict";
	}
	ed.multiline = !ed.isNew && (ed.id === -1 ? /[\r\n]/.test(ed.origSource) : this.getAdapter().isMultiline(this.model, ed.id));
	ed.caret = hint.caret || null;
	this.placeEditor(!!hint.focused);
	if(hint.focused) {
		this.focusEditor();
	}
	return true;
};

// True when the buffer differs from what the editor started with (new unit: anything typed)
methods.editChanged = function() {
	var ed = this.editor,
		text = this.wiki.getTiddlerText(this.bufferTitle());
	if(!ed || text === undefined) {
		return false;
	}
	return ed.isNew ? /\S/.test(text) : text !== ed.origSource;
};

/*
The widget goes away (ancestor re-render, tiddler closed, outline mode off): close the editor. A changed buffer
is kept for the next widget of this tiddler (restoreEditor), with the focus and caret; otherwise it is discarded.
*/
methods.releaseEditor = function() {
	if(!this.editor) {
		return;
	}
	var keep = this.ownsBuffer() && this.editChanged();
	if(keep) {
		var engine = this.editorEngine(),
			caret = engine && engine.domNode && typeof engine.domNode.selectionStart === "number" ?
				[engine.domNode.selectionStart, engine.domNode.selectionEnd] : null;
		registryOf(restoreHints, this.wiki)[this.bufferTitle()] = {focused: this.editor.focused, caret: caret};
	}
	this.closeEditor(!keep);
};

// Create host + editor widget at the place of this.editor.id (or at the end of the container).
// focus: whether the new editor takes the focus when it renders
methods.placeEditor = function(focus) {
	var ed = this.editor,
		nodes = ed.id === -1 ? [] : this.units[ed.id].domNodes,
		host = this.document.createElement(ed.placement === "after" && ed.unitKind === "item" && nodes.length ? "li" : "div"),
		self = this;
	host.className = HOST_CLASS;
	if(!nodes.length) {
		this.domNode.appendChild(host);
	} else if(ed.placement === "after") {
		var last = nodes[nodes.length - 1];
		last.parentNode.insertBefore(host, dom.nextSiblingOf(last));
	} else if(ed.placement === "inside") {
		nodes[0].insertBefore(host, nodes[0].firstChild || null);
	} else {
		nodes[0].parentNode.insertBefore(host, nodes[0]);
	}
	host.addEventListener("keydown", function(event) { self.handleEditorKeydown(event); }, false);
	host.addEventListener("focusin", function() { if(self.editor) { self.editor.focused = true; } }, false);
	host.addEventListener("focusout", function() { if(self.editor) { self.editor.focused = false; } }, false);
	ed.host = host;
	this.hideEdited();
	// The host is in the document now: the FramedEngine needs that to create its iframe
	ed.widget = this.wiki.makeTranscludeWidget(EDITOR_TIDDLER, {
		parentWidget: this,
		document: this.document,
		variables: {
			"outline-edit-tiddler": this.bufferTitle(),
			"len": String(this.wiki.getTiddlerText(this.bufferTitle(), "").length),
			"outline-edit-focus": focus ? "yes" : "no"
		}
	});
	ed.widget.render(host, null);
	this.trackEngineFocus();
	if(ed.notice) {
		this.showNotice(ed.notice);
	}
};

// The FramedEngine's textarea lives in an iframe: its focus events do not reach the host
methods.trackEngineFocus = function() {
	var ed = this.editor,
		engine = this.editorEngine(),
		self = this;
	if(!engine || !engine.domNode || !engine.domNode.addEventListener) {
		return;
	}
	engine.domNode.addEventListener("focus", function() { if(self.editor === ed) { ed.focused = true; } }, false);
	engine.domNode.addEventListener("blur", function() { if(self.editor === ed) { ed.focused = false; } }, false);
	var active = this.document.activeElement;
	ed.focused = !!active && (active === engine.domNode || active === engine.iframeNode);
};

methods.hideEdited = function() {
	var ed = this.editor;
	this.unhideEdited();
	if(ed.placement === "after" || ed.id === -1) {
		return;
	}
	var cls = ed.placement === "inside" ? EDITING_OWN_CLASS : EDITING_CLASS;
	ed.hidden = this.units[ed.id].domNodes.slice();
	$tw.utils.each(ed.hidden, function(node) {
		dom.setClass(node, cls, true);
	});
};

methods.unhideEdited = function() {
	var ed = this.editor;
	$tw.utils.each(ed && ed.hidden || [], function(node) {
		dom.setClass(node, EDITING_CLASS, false);
		dom.setClass(node, EDITING_OWN_CLASS, false);
	});
	if(ed) {
		ed.hidden = [];
	}
};

// Remove host and editor widget; release the buffer, and delete it when `discard`
methods.closeEditor = function(discard) {
	if(!this.editor) {
		return;
	}
	this.unhideEdited();
	this.removeHost();
	this.editor = null;
	if(this.ownsBuffer()) {
		delete ownersOf(this.wiki)[this.bufferTitle()];
		if(discard) {
			this.wiki.deleteTiddler(this.bufferTitle());
		}
	}
};

methods.removeHost = function() {
	var ed = this.editor;
	if(ed.widget) {
		ed.widget.destroy({removeDOMNodes: false});
		ed.widget = null;
	}
	if(ed.host && ed.host.parentNode) {
		ed.host.parentNode.removeChild(ed.host);
	}
	ed.host = null;
};

methods.cancelEdit = function() {
	if(!this.editor) {
		return false;
	}
	this.closeEditor(true);
	dom.focus(this.domNode);
	return true;
};

/*
Save: splice the buffer into the unit's range (or insert the new unit) and write the tiddler once.
Blank text: a new unit writes nothing; an existing unit without children is deleted, one with children is
refused with a notice. If the unit cannot be located safely after an outside change, the editor stays
open with a conflict notice and the buffer is kept. Returns true when the editor was closed.
*/
methods.saveEdit = function(opts) {
	opts = opts || {};
	var ed = this.editor;
	if(!ed) {
		return false;
	}
	var newSource = this.wiki.getTiddlerText(this.bufferTitle(), ""),
		blank = !/\S/.test(newSource);
	if(ed.isNew && blank) {
		// Nothing typed into a new unit: nothing to write, a continue chain ends here
		this.closeEditor(true);
		dom.focus(this.domNode);
		return true;
	}
	if(this.isReadOnly()) {
		this.showNotice("readonly");
		return false;
	}
	var tiddler = this.wiki.getTiddler(this.tiddlerTitle),
		current = tiddler ? (tiddler.fields.text || "") : "",
		adapter = this.getAdapter(),
		target = tiddler && adapter ? this.locateEditUnit(current) : null;
	if(!target) {
		this.showNotice("conflict");
		return false;
	}
	var result;
	if(ed.isNew) {
		result = adapter.insertNew(current, target.model, target.id, newSource.replace(/\r?\n/g, utils.eol(current)));
		if(!result) {
			// Nothing left to insert (e.g. only the item marker was typed): like a blank new unit
			this.closeEditor(true);
			dom.focus(this.domNode);
			return true;
		}
	} else if(blank) {
		result = adapter.remove(current, target.model, target.id);
		if(!result) {
			this.showNotice("children");
			return false;
		}
	} else {
		result = adapter.replace(current, target.model, target.id, newSource.replace(/\r?\n/g, utils.eol(current)));
	}
	var kind = ed.kind,
		index = ed.isNew ? target.id + 1 : target.id;
	this.closeEditor(true);
	dom.focus(this.domNode);
	var written = result.text !== current;
	if(written) {
		this.writeText(tiddler, result.text);
	}
	this.saveSelection(result.select, index, blank ? "" : kind);
	if(opts["continue"] && !blank) {
		this.pendingContinue = {start: result.select, kind: kind};
		if(!written) {
			this.runPendingContinue();
		}
	} else if(!written) {
		this.restoreSelection();
	}
	return true;
};

/*
{model, id} of the edited unit (or anchor) in `text`, or null when it cannot be located safely.
Unchanged text: the original unit. Otherwise: the one unit of the same kind whose own source equals the
original own source; none or several -> null.
*/
methods.locateEditUnit = function(text) {
	var ed = this.editor,
		m = this.model && this.model.text === text ? this.model : model.buildModel(this.wiki, text, this.tiddlerTitle);
	if(text === ed.origText) {
		var same = model.findUnit(m, ed.origStart, ed.unitKind);
		return same === -1 ? null : {model: m, id: same};
	}
	var found = m.units.filter(function(u) {
		return u.kind === ed.unitKind && text.substring(u.start, u.end) === ed.origSource;
	});
	return found.length === 1 ? {model: m, id: found[0].id} : null;
};

// After a re-render: open the new unit requested by saveEdit({continue: true})
methods.runPendingContinue = function() {
	var pending = this.pendingContinue;
	this.pendingContinue = null;
	if(!pending || this.editor) {
		return;
	}
	var id = model.findUnit(this.model, pending.start, pending.kind);
	if(id !== -1) {
		this.startEdit(id, {isNew: true});
	}
};

/*
After the body was (re-)mapped: put the host next to the relocated unit again. When the host is still in
place it is left alone (moving an iframe reloads it). Otherwise the editor widget is created again from the
buffer, so typed text is kept. It gets the focus (and caret) back only if it had the focus before.
*/
methods.reattachEditor = function() {
	var ed = this.editor;
	if(!ed) {
		if(!this.restoreEditor()) {
			this.runPendingContinue();
		}
		return;
	}
	var target = this.locateEditUnit(this.model.text);
	ed.id = target && this.isSelectable(target.id) ? target.id : -1;
	if(this.hostInPlace()) {
		this.hideEdited();
		return;
	}
	if(ed.id === -1 && dom.isInside(ed.host, this.domNode)) {
		// Unit not found (the save will report the conflict): leave the editor where it is
		this.unhideEdited();
		return;
	}
	var hadFocus = ed.focused,
		engine = this.editorEngine();
	ed.caret = null;
	if(engine && engine.domNode && typeof engine.domNode.selectionStart === "number") {
		ed.caret = [engine.domNode.selectionStart, engine.domNode.selectionEnd];
	}
	this.unhideEdited();
	this.removeHost();
	this.placeEditor(hadFocus);
	if(hadFocus) {
		this.focusEditor();
	}
};

// True when the host is attached inside the container at the place the unit asks for
methods.hostInPlace = function() {
	var ed = this.editor;
	if(ed.id === -1 || !dom.isInside(ed.host, this.domNode)) {
		return false;
	}
	var nodes = this.units[ed.id].domNodes;
	if(ed.placement === "after") {
		return dom.nextSiblingOf(nodes[nodes.length - 1]) === ed.host;
	}
	if(ed.placement === "inside") {
		return ed.host.parentNode === nodes[0] && nodes[0].firstChild === ed.host;
	}
	return dom.nextSiblingOf(ed.host) === nodes[0];
};

methods.editorEngine = function() {
	var found = null;
	function walk(widget) {
		if(found || !widget) {
			return;
		}
		if(widget.engine) {
			found = widget.engine;
			return;
		}
		$tw.utils.each(widget.children, walk);
	}
	walk(this.editor && this.editor.widget);
	return found;
};

methods.focusEditor = function() {
	var engine = this.editorEngine();
	if(engine && engine.focus && $tw.browser) {
		engine.focus();
		var caret = this.editor.caret,
			len = (engine.domNode && engine.domNode.value || "").length;
		if(caret && engine.domNode && engine.domNode.setSelectionRange) {
			engine.domNode.setSelectionRange(Math.min(caret[0], len), Math.min(caret[1], len));
		}
		this.editor.focused = true;
	}
};

// Show notice `name` (NOTICES) at the top of the host; replaces a previous notice
methods.showNotice = function(name) {
	var ed = this.editor,
		info = NOTICES[name];
	ed.notice = name;
	if(!ed.host) {
		return;
	}
	var children = Array.prototype.slice.call(ed.host.childNodes || []);
	$tw.utils.each(children, function(child) {
		if(child.nodeType === 1 && (child.className || "").split(" ").indexOf("rr-ol-notice") !== -1) {
			ed.host.removeChild(child);
		}
	});
	var note = this.document.createElement("div");
	note.className = info.cls;
	note.appendChild(this.document.createTextNode(info.text));
	ed.host.insertBefore(note, ed.host.firstChild || null);
};

// Insert a line break at the caret through the engine (keeps undo, height and the buffer in sync)
methods.insertNewline = function() {
	var engine = this.editorEngine();
	if(!engine || !engine.widget || !engine.widget.handleEditTextOperationMessage) {
		return;
	}
	engine.widget.handleEditTextOperationMessage({
		type: "tm-edit-text-operation",
		param: "insert-text",
		paramObject: {text: "\n"}
	});
};

/*
Keys while editing. Events already handled elsewhere (AutoComplete popup) are ignored.
Multi-line units (code blocks, tables, widgets, multi-line items) get native Enter and Shift-Enter.
*/
methods.handleEditorKeydown = function(event) {
	var ed = this.editor;
	if(!ed || event.defaultPrevented) {
		return;
	}
	if(this.keyMatches(event, "outline-save")) {
		this.saveEdit();
	} else if(!ed.multiline && this.keyMatches(event, "outline-continue")) {
		this.saveEdit({"continue": true});
	} else if(!ed.multiline && this.keyMatches(event, "outline-newline")) {
		this.insertNewline();
	} else if(this.keyMatches(event, "outline-cancel")) {
		this.cancelEdit();
	} else {
		return;
	}
	event.preventDefault();
	event.stopPropagation();
};

// Select-mode Shift-Enter
methods.editSelected = function() {
	if(this.selectedId === -1) {
		return false;
	}
	this.startEdit(this.selectedId);
	return true;
};

// Set outline mode on for `title` and open it in the story
methods.openTarget = function(title) {
	if(!title) {
		return false;
	}
	this.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({title: STATE_PREFIX + title, text: "yes"}));
	this.dispatchEvent({
		type: "tm-navigate",
		navigateTo: title,
		navigateFromTitle: this.tiddlerTitle,
		navigateFromNode: this
	});
	return true;
};

methods.getAdapter = function() {
	var tiddler = this.wiki.getTiddler(this.tiddlerTitle);
	return formats.getFormat(tiddler ? tiddler.fields.type : "");
};

exports.install = function(proto) {
	$tw.utils.each(methods, function(fn, name) {
		proto[name] = fn;
	});
};

type: application/javascript
module-type: library

Selection, configurable keys and structural operations of the $outline widget.
install(proto) adds these methods to the widget prototype. They use widget.model, widget.units,
widget.domNode and widget.tiddlerTitle (see outline-widget.js).

Selection state: $:/temp/rimir/outline/selection/<title> with fields start, index and kind.

and its first item share a start). Otherwise the saved index, clamped. Units without DOM nodes cannot
be selected.

"use strict";

var formats = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/formats.js"),
	findUnit = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js").findUnit,
	checkOp = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js").checkOp,
	dom = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/dom-utils.js"),
	setClass = dom.setClass,
	focus = dom.focus,
	isInside = dom.isInside,
	isEditable = dom.isEditable,
	scrollIntoView = dom.scrollIntoView;

var SELECTION_PREFIX = "$:/temp/rimir/outline/selection/",
	READ_ONLY = "$:/status/IsReadOnly",
	SELECTED_CLASS = "rr-ol-selected";

/*
Select-mode actions in matching order. run returns true when the key is consumed. Structural keys
(operate) are consumed whenever a unit is selected, even when nothing changes or the wiki is read-only,
so Tab never moves the focus away from a selection. In read-only wikis only up/down/clear/open act.
*/
var ACTIONS = [
	{name: "outline-up", run: function(w) { return w.step(-1); }},
	{name: "outline-down", run: function(w) { return w.step(1); }},
	{name: "outline-clear", run: function(w) { return w.clearSelection(); }},
	{name: "outline-open", run: function(w) { return w.openTransclusion(); }},
	{name: "outline-edit", run: function(w) { return w.editSelected(); }},
	{name: "outline-move-up", run: function(w) { return w.operate("move", -1); }},
	{name: "outline-move-down", run: function(w) { return w.operate("move", 1); }},
	{name: "outline-indent", run: function(w) { return w.operate("indent"); }},
	{name: "outline-promote", run: function(w) { return w.operate("promote"); }}
];

var methods = {};

/* ---------- selection ---------- */

methods.selectionTitle = function() {
	return SELECTION_PREFIX + this.tiddlerTitle;
};

methods.isSelectable = function(id) {
	var entry = this.units[id];
	return !!entry && entry.domNodes.length > 0;
};

// Select unit `id` and save the selection. Returns false for units that cannot be selected.
methods.select = function(id) {
	if(!this.isSelectable(id)) {
		return false;
	}
	var unit = this.units[id].unit;
	this.saveSelection(unit.start, id, unit.kind);
	this.showSelection(id);
	return true;
};

methods.clearSelection = function() {
	if(this.selectedId === -1) {
		return false;
	}
	this.wiki.deleteTiddler(this.selectionTitle());
	this.showSelection(-1);
	return true;
};

methods.saveSelection = function(start, index, kind) {
	this.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({
		title: this.selectionTitle(),
		start: String(start),
		index: String(index),
		kind: kind || ""
	}));
};

// Unit id for the saved selection in the current mapping, or -1
methods.resolveSelection = function() {
	var state = this.wiki.getTiddler(this.selectionTitle()),
		self = this;
	if(!state || !this.units.length) {
		return -1;
	}
	var id = findUnit(this.model, parseInt(state.fields.start, 10), state.fields.kind, function(i) {
		return self.isSelectable(i);
	});
	if(id !== -1) {
		return id;
	}
	var index = parseInt(state.fields.index, 10);
	if(isNaN(index)) {
		return -1;
	}
	index = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, this.units.length - 1));
	return this.nearestSelectable(index);
};

// `index` itself if selectable, else the next selectable unit after it, else the one before it
methods.nearestSelectable = function(index) {
	var i;
	for(i = index; i < this.units.length; i++) {
		if(this.isSelectable(i)) { return i; }
	}
	for(i = index - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
		if(this.isSelectable(i)) { return i; }
	}
	return -1;
};

// Move the selection frame to unit `id` (-1: none) without touching the state tiddler
methods.showSelection = function(id) {
	$tw.utils.each(this.selectedNodes || [], function(node) {
		setClass(node, SELECTED_CLASS, false);
	});
	this.selectedId = id;
	this.selectedNodes = id === -1 ? [] : this.units[id].domNodes.slice();
	$tw.utils.each(this.selectedNodes, function(node) {
		setClass(node, SELECTED_CLASS, true);
	});
};

// Re-apply the saved selection after (re-)mapping
methods.restoreSelection = function() {
	this.showSelection(this.resolveSelection());
};

// Select the previous (-1) or next (1) selectable unit. Without a selection: the first or last one.
methods.step = function(dir) {
	// Positions of an unrendered change are stale: remap first (selecting writes nothing)
	this.ensureCurrent();
	var id = this.selectedId, i;
	if(id === -1) {
		i = dir > 0 ? this.nearestSelectable(0) : this.lastSelectable();
	} else {
		for(i = id + dir; i >= 0 && i < this.units.length && !this.isSelectable(i); i += dir) {}
		if(i < 0 || i >= this.units.length) {
			i = id;
		}
	}
	if(i === -1) {
		return false;
	}
	this.select(i);
	scrollIntoView(this.units[i].domNodes[0]);
	return true;
};

methods.lastSelectable = function() {
	for(var i = this.units.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
		if(this.isSelectable(i)) { return i; }
	}
	return -1;
};

/* ---------- operations ---------- */

// Enter on a transclusion unit: open the transcluded tiddler in outline mode (openTarget: outline-editor.js)
methods.openTransclusion = function() {
	var id = this.selectedId;
	if(id === -1 || this.units[id].unit.kind !== "transclusion") {
		return false;
	}
	this.openTarget(this.units[id].unit.target);
	return true;
};

/*
Run adapter operation `name` on the selected unit. Returns true when a unit is selected (the key is
consumed), whether or not the text changed. A result that fails the model guard (checkOp) is not written.
*/
methods.operate = function(name, arg) {
	var id = this.selectedId;
	if(id === -1) {
		return false;
	}
	// Read-only, or an open editor in this view (a move could rewrite the edited unit): consumed, no write
	if(this.isReadOnly() || this.editor) {
		return true;
	}
	if(!this.ensureCurrent()) {
		return true;
	}
	id = this.selectedId;
	var tiddler = this.wiki.getTiddler(this.tiddlerTitle),
		text = tiddler.fields.text || "",
		adapter = formats.getFormat(tiddler.fields.type);
	if(!adapter || !adapter[name]) {
		return true;
	}
	var result = adapter[name](text, this.model, id, arg);
	// Guard: never write a result that changes units the operation must leave alone
	if(result && result.text !== text && !checkOp(this.wiki, this.model, id, name, result.text, this.tiddlerTitle)) {
		return true;
	}
	this.applyResult(result);
	return true;
};

/*
True when the positions of this.model fit the tiddler's current text (the tiddler exists). When the text changed
and that change has not been rendered yet, the body is rebuilt first. If the change is this view's own last write
(a key pressed before the refresh after a write), the rebuilt mapping and the restored selection are valid and
the result is true; after any other change it is false (positions are not trusted for a write: do nothing).
*/
methods.ensureCurrent = function() {
	var tiddler = this.wiki.getTiddler(this.tiddlerTitle),
		text = tiddler ? (tiddler.fields.text || "") : "";
	if(tiddler && text === this.model.text) {
		return true;
	}
	this.rebuild();
	return !!tiddler && text === this.lastWritten && this.model.text === text && this.selectedId !== -1;
};

// Write `text` to the tiddler (one change) and remember it as this view's own last write
methods.writeText = function(tiddler, text) {
	this.lastWritten = text;
	this.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(tiddler, {text: text}, this.wiki.getModificationFields()));
};

/*
Write the adapter result {text, select} to the tiddler (once) and save the selection at the new start.
null (no-op) writes nothing; a result whose text equals the current text only saves the selection.
*/
methods.applyResult = function(result) {
	if(!result) {
		return false;
	}
	var old = this.wiki.getTiddler(this.tiddlerTitle),
		id = this.selectedId,
		kind = id === -1 ? "" : this.units[id].unit.kind;
	// Same text (e.g. two identical siblings swapped): no write, but the frame still follows result.select
	if(!old || result.text !== (old.fields.text || "")) {
		this.writeText(old, result.text);
	}
	this.saveSelection(result.select, id === -1 ? 0 : id, kind);
	return true;
};

methods.isReadOnly = function() {
	return this.wiki.getTiddlerText(READ_ONLY) === "yes";
};

/* ---------- events ---------- */

methods.handleKeydown = function(event) {
	// Consumed elsewhere (AutoComplete popups listen in the capture phase), or from an element inside
	if(event.defaultPrevented || event.target !== this.domNode) {
		return;
	}
	for(var i = 0; i < ACTIONS.length; i++) {
		var action = ACTIONS[i];
		if(this.keyMatches(event, action.name) && action.run(this)) {
			event.preventDefault();
			event.stopPropagation();
			return;
		}
	}
};

methods.keyMatches = function(event, name) {
	var km = $tw.keyboardManager;
	return !!km && km.checkKeyDescriptors(event, km.parseKeyDescriptors("((" + name + "))", {wiki: this.wiki}));
};

/*
Click on a transclusion marker opens its target. Click on a stamped element selects its unit and focuses
the container. Clicks inside the editor host are left to the editor.
*/
methods.handleClick = function(event) {
	var node = event.target;
	if(this.editor && this.editor.host && isInside(node, this.editor.host)) {
		return;
	}
	for(var m = node; m && m !== this.domNode; m = m.parentNode) {
		if(m.getAttribute && m.getAttribute("data-ol-target")) {
			event.preventDefault();
			event.stopPropagation();
			this.openTarget(m.getAttribute("data-ol-target"));
			return;
		}
	}
	while(node && node !== this.domNode) {
		if(node.getAttribute && node.getAttribute("data-ol-id") !== null && node.getAttribute("data-ol-id") !== undefined) {
			if(this.select(parseInt(node.getAttribute("data-ol-id"), 10)) && !isEditable(event.target)) {
				focus(this.domNode);
			}
			return;
		}
		node = node.parentNode;
	}
};

exports.install = function(proto) {
	$tw.utils.each(methods, function(fn, name) {
		proto[name] = fn;
	});
};

title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/outline-widget.js
type: application/javascript
module-type: widget

The $outline widget: wraps the normal body transclusion of a tiddler, maps the units of its
text to the rendered DOM nodes and stamps them with data-ol-* attributes.

<$outline tiddler=<<currentTiddler>>><$transclude $tiddler=<<currentTiddler>> $mode="block"/></$outline>

After render and refresh:
  widget.model      - buildModel() of the tiddler text
  widget.units      - [{unit, domNodes:[Element]}] in model order
  widget.selectedId - selected unit id or -1 (selection and keys: outline-keys.js)
  widget.editor     - open in-place editor or null (outline-editor.js); re-attached after each mapping

Matching rule (unit <-> widget): a widget matches a unit when its parseTreeNode.start equals the
unit's anchor (the unit start; for $$$ typed blocks the start of the line after the $$$ header,
where the parser starts the node) and its tag (element tag, else parse node type) equals unit.tag.
Each unit matches once, in document order. `end` is only a tie-breaker, because the model trims
trailing line breaks and extends lists to their subtree end.

\*/
"use strict";

var Widget = require("$:/core/modules/widgets/widget.js").widget,
	buildModel = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js").buildModel,
	keys = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/outline-keys.js"),
	editor = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/outline-editor.js");

var MARKER_TIDDLER = "$:/plugins/rimir/outline/ui/transclusion-marker",
	LIST_TAGS = {ul: true, ol: true, dl: true, blockquote: true},
	// Kinds whose widgets may contain further units
	DESCEND_KINDS = {list: true, item: true, container: true},
	// A <span> directly inside these is invalid HTML: the marker goes into their first cell/item
	MARKER_INTO = {ul: "li", ol: "li", dl: "dt dd", table: "td th"};

var OutlineWidget = function(parseTreeNode, options) {
	this.initialise(parseTreeNode, options);
};

OutlineWidget.prototype = new Widget();

// Selection, keys and structural operations: select, step, operate, applyResult, handleKeydown, handleClick
keys.install(OutlineWidget.prototype);
// In-place editor: startEdit, saveEdit, cancelEdit, reattachEditor, handleEditorKeydown, openTarget
editor.install(OutlineWidget.prototype);

OutlineWidget.prototype.render = function(parent, nextSibling) {
	this.parentDomNode = parent;
	this.computeAttributes();
	this.execute();
	var domNode = this.document.createElement("div");
	domNode.className = "rr-ol";
	domNode.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
	var self = this;
	domNode.addEventListener("keydown", function(event) { self.handleKeydown(event); }, false);
	domNode.addEventListener("click", function(event) { self.handleClick(event); }, false);
	parent.insertBefore(domNode, nextSibling);
	this.renderChildren(domNode, null);
	this.domNodes.push(domNode);
	this.domNode = domNode;
	this.mapUnits();
};

OutlineWidget.prototype.execute = function() {
	this.tiddlerTitle = this.getAttribute("tiddler", this.getVariable("currentTiddler"));
	this.model = null;
	this.units = [];
	this.markers = [];
	this.selectedId = -1;
	this.selectedNodes = [];
	this.editor = null;
	this.pendingContinue = null;
	this.markerHtml = null;
	this.lastWritten = null;
	this.makeChildWidgets();
};

OutlineWidget.prototype.refresh = function(changedTiddlers) {
	var changedAttributes = this.computeAttributes();
	if(changedAttributes.tiddler) {
		this.refreshSelf();
		return true;
	}
	if(changedTiddlers[MARKER_TIDDLER]) {
		this.markerHtml = null;
	}
	var refreshed = this.refreshChildren(changedTiddlers);
	if(this.editor && this.editor.widget) {
		this.editor.widget.refresh(changedTiddlers);
	}
	if(refreshed || changedTiddlers[this.tiddlerTitle]) {
		this.mapUnits();
	} else if(changedTiddlers[this.selectionTitle()]) {
		this.restoreSelection();
	}
	return refreshed;
};

/*
Remove the editor (it is not part of the children). A changed buffer is kept and reopened by the next widget of
this tiddler (an ancestor re-render destroys this widget); an unchanged one is discarded (releaseEditor).
*/
OutlineWidget.prototype.destroy = function(options) {
	this.releaseEditor();
	Widget.prototype.destroy.call(this, options);
};

/*
Re-render the children into the same container (keeps the focus) and remap. Used when the text changed
before the change was rendered.
*/
OutlineWidget.prototype.rebuild = function() {
	this.clearStamps();
	this.showSelection(-1);
	$tw.utils.each(this.children, function(child) {
		child.destroy({removeDOMNodes: true});
	});
	this.makeChildWidgets();
	this.renderChildren(this.domNode, null);
	this.mapUnits();
};

/*
Rebuild the model (when the text changed), match units to widgets, stamp the DOM nodes and
add the transclusion markers. Fills this.model and this.units.
*/
OutlineWidget.prototype.mapUnits = function() {
	var text = this.wiki.getTiddlerText(this.tiddlerTitle, "");
	if(!this.model || this.model.text !== text) {
		this.model = buildModel(this.wiki, text, this.tiddlerTitle);
	}
	this.clearStamps();
	var units = this.model.units,
		domNodes = this.matchUnits(),
		self = this;
	this.units = units.map(function(unit) {
		return {unit: unit, domNodes: domNodes[unit.id] || []};
	});
	$tw.utils.each(this.units, function(entry) {
		self.stamp(entry);
	});
	this.restoreSelection();
	this.reattachEditor();
};

// Remove stamps and markers of the previous mapping (DOM nodes that were not re-rendered keep them otherwise)
OutlineWidget.prototype.clearStamps = function() {
	$tw.utils.each(this.units, function(entry) {
		$tw.utils.each(entry.domNodes, function(node) {
			node.removeAttribute("data-ol-id");
			node.removeAttribute("data-ol-kind");
			node.removeAttribute("data-ol-start");
		});
	});
	$tw.utils.each(this.markers, function(marker) {
		if(marker.parentNode) {
			marker.parentNode.removeChild(marker);
		}
	});
	this.markers = [];
};

OutlineWidget.prototype.stamp = function(entry) {
	var unit = entry.unit;
	$tw.utils.each(entry.domNodes, function(node) {
		node.setAttribute("data-ol-id", unit.id);
		node.setAttribute("data-ol-kind", unit.kind);
		node.setAttribute("data-ol-start", unit.start);
	});
	if(unit.kind === "transclusion" && entry.domNodes.length) {
		this.addMarker(entry.domNodes[0], unit.target);
	}
};

OutlineWidget.prototype.addMarker = function(node, target) {
	var marker = this.document.createElement("span");
	marker.className = "rr-ol-tmark";
	marker.setAttribute("title", target);
	marker.setAttribute("data-ol-target", target);
	if(this.markerHtml === null) {
		this.markerHtml = this.wiki.renderTiddler("text/html", MARKER_TIDDLER, {parseAsInline: true});
	}
	marker.innerHTML = this.markerHtml;
	markerParent(node).appendChild(marker);
	this.markers.push(marker);
};

// The element that takes the marker: the node itself, or for lists and tables their first item/cell
function markerParent(node) {
	var into = MARKER_INTO[(node.tagName || "").toLowerCase()];
	return (into && firstDescendant(node, into.split(" "))) || node;
}

function firstDescendant(node, tags) {
	var children = node.childNodes || [];
	for(var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
		var child = children[i];
		if(child.nodeType !== 1) {
			continue;
		}
		if(tags.indexOf((child.tagName || "").toLowerCase()) !== -1) {
			return child;
		}
		var found = firstDescendant(child, tags);
		if(found) {
			return found;
		}
	}
	return null;
}

/*
Walk the widget tree below the body transclusion of the tiddler and return {unitId: [Element]}.
*/
OutlineWidget.prototype.matchUnits = function() {
	var self = this,
		text = this.model.text,
		result = {},
		used = {},
		byAnchor = {};
	$tw.utils.each(this.model.units, function(unit) {
		var anchor = unitAnchor(text, unit);
		(byAnchor[anchor] = byAnchor[anchor] || []).push(unit);
	});
	var body = this.findBodyTransclude(this);
	if(!body) {
		return result;
	}
	function walk(widget) {
		$tw.utils.each(widget.children, function(child) {
			var unit = self.matchWidget(child, byAnchor, used);
			if(unit) {
				used[unit.id] = true;
				result[unit.id] = elementNodes(child);
				if(DESCEND_KINDS[unit.kind]) {
					walk(child);
				}
			} else if(!isForeign(child, self.tiddlerTitle)) {
				walk(child);
			}
		});
	}
	walk(body);
	return result;
};

// First descendant transclude widget that renders this tiddler
OutlineWidget.prototype.findBodyTransclude = function(widget) {
	for(var i = 0; i < widget.children.length; i++) {
		var child = widget.children[i];
		if(child.parseTreeNode && child.parseTreeNode.type === "transclude" &&
			!child.transcludeVariable && child.transcludeTitle === this.tiddlerTitle && rendersText(child)) {
			return child;
		}
		var found = this.findBodyTransclude(child);
		if(found) {
			return found;
		}
	}
	return null;
};

OutlineWidget.prototype.matchWidget = function(widget, byAnchor, used) {
	var node = widget.parseTreeNode;
	if(!node || typeof node.start !== "number") {
		return null;
	}
	var tag = node.type === "element" ? node.tag : node.type,
		candidates = (byAnchor[node.start] || []).filter(function(unit) {
			return !used[unit.id] && unit.tag === tag;
		});
	if(!candidates.length || isSyntheticItem(node)) {
		return null;
	}
	// Tie-breaker: same end (the model trims trailing line breaks, so compare trimmed)
	for(var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
		if(candidates[i].end === node.end || candidates[i].end === trimEnd(this.model.text, node.start, node.end)) {
			return candidates[i];
		}
	}
	return candidates[0];
};

// Where the parser starts the node of a unit: $$$ typed blocks start after their header line
function unitAnchor(text, unit) {
	if(unit.kind === "block" && text.substr(unit.start, 3) === "$$$") {
		var nl = text.indexOf("\n", unit.start);
		if(nl !== -1) {
			return nl + 1;
		}
	}
	return unit.start;
}

function trimEnd(text, start, end) {
	end = Math.min(end, text.length);
	while(end > start && (text.charAt(end - 1) === "\n" || text.charAt(end - 1) === "\r")) {
		end--;
	}
	return end;
}

// Skipped list levels produce an item that only holds a deeper list starting at the same position
function isSyntheticItem(node) {
	var first = node.children && node.children[0];
	return node.type === "element" && !!first && first.type === "element" &&
		LIST_TAGS[first.tag] && first.start === node.start;
}

/*
A transclude widget of another tiddler, of a variable, or of another field or an index of this tiddler: its
positions refer to another text
*/
function isForeign(widget, title) {
	var node = widget.parseTreeNode;
	return !!node && node.type === "transclude" &&
		(!!widget.transcludeVariable || widget.transcludeTitle !== title || !rendersText(widget));
}

// True when a transclude widget renders the text field (no other field, no index)
function rendersText(widget) {
	return (!widget.transcludeField || widget.transcludeField === "text") && !widget.transcludeIndex;
}

// The widget's own element nodes, or for DOM-less widgets the top-level element nodes of its descendants
function elementNodes(widget) {
	var own = (widget.domNodes || []).filter(isElement);
	if(own.length || (widget.domNodes || []).length) {
		return own;
	}
	var out = [];
	$tw.utils.each(widget.children, function(child) {
		out.push.apply(out, elementNodes(child));
	});
	return out;
}

function isElement(node) {
	return !!node && node.nodeType === 1;
}

exports.outline = OutlineWidget;

Work on an ordinary tiddler like on a Streams outline: select a block, edit it in place, move it with Alt-Up/Down, indent it with Tab, and see the result rendered at once. The tiddler stays one tiddler; no helper tiddlers are created.

!! Features

* ''Toggle per tiddler'' — an //outline// button in the view toolbar. Off means the normal view, with no extra handlers.
* ''Same rendering'' — the tiddler renders exactly as usual. Outline mode only adds data attributes, a selection frame and key handling.
* ''Units'' — list items, lists, headings (with their sections), paragraphs, code blocks, tables, opened HTML containers, transclusion lines, and widgets or macro calls (one opaque unit each).
* ''Selection'' — click, Up/Down in document order, Escape clears.
* ''Move'' — Alt-Up/Alt-Down swap a unit with its sibling, carrying its subtree. Moves stay inside the parent.
* ''Indent'' — Tab/Shift-Tab demote/promote list items (one marker character) and headings (one `!`) with their subtrees.
* ''In-place editor'' — Shift-Enter opens TW's own edit widget at the unit (AutoComplete and other editor plugins work). Ctrl-Enter saves, Enter saves and starts a new unit, Escape discards.
* ''Transclusions'' — a small marker on `{{…}}` lines; Enter opens the target in outline mode.
* ''Safe writes'' — every write is a splice of a known range; if the text changed underneath, the edit is relocated or refused, never guessed.

!! Prerequisites

* TiddlyWiki 5.4.0 or later (JS modules: server restart or reload needed after install)
* Optional: `rimir/theme` (`rr-` styles in settings), `rimir/doc-template` (branded docs)

!! Quick Start

# Install the plugin and restart the server (the widget and key modules load only at startup).
# Open a wikitext tiddler and press //outline// in its view toolbar.
# Click a block. Move with Up/Down, press Alt-Down to move it below its sibling, Tab to indent it.
# Press Shift-Enter, change the text, press Ctrl-Enter to save.

Wikitext only; Markdown tiddlers are not supported yet.
