range end (mapped to the same lengths relative to the end of the text) is unchanged.
`ranges` are [[start,end]] in `before`. The tail is compared against the same
suffix of `before` that follows the largest end.
*/
exports.assertOnlyRangesChanged = function(before, after, ranges, expect) {
	// `expect` must be passed from the spec: Jasmine's global is not visible inside TW modules
	if(typeof expect !== "function") {
		throw new Error("assertOnlyRangesChanged: the expect argument is required");
	}
	var min = Infinity, max = -Infinity;
	(ranges || []).forEach(function(r) {
		if(r[0] < min) { min = r[0]; }
		if(r[1] > max) { max = r[1]; }
	});
	if(min === Infinity) {
		expect(after).toBe(before);
		return;
	}
	var prefix = before.substring(0, min),
		suffix = before.substring(max);

	expect(after.length).not.toBeLessThan(prefix.length + suffix.length);
	expect(after.substring(after.length - suffix.length)).toBe(suffix);
};

exports.unitSignature = function(model) {
	return model.units.map(function(u) {
		return u.kind + ":" + u.level + ":" + u.parent;
	});

title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/test-edit.js
type: application/javascript
tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]]

Tests for replace, insertNew, editSource and isMultiline in format-wikitext.js.

\*/
"use strict";

var model = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js"),
	fmt = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/format-wikitext.js"),
	fixtures = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/fixtures.js");

describe("outline edit", function() {

	function build(text) { return model.buildModel($tw.wiki, text); }
	function unit(m, pred) { return m.units.filter(pred)[0]; }
	function idOf(m, s) {
		// last match = innermost (a list and its only item can share a source)
		var all = m.units.filter(function(u) { return m.text.substring(u.start, u.end) === s; });
		return all[all.length - 1].id;
	}

	it("replace keeps rest", function() {
		var text = "* a\n** a1\n* b", m = build(text), u = m.units[idOf(m, "* a")],
			r = fmt.replace(text, m, u.id, "* changed");
		expect(r.text).toBe("* changed\n** a1\n* b");
		expect(r.select).toBe(0);
		fixtures.assertOnlyRangesChanged(text, r.text, [[u.start, u.end]], expect);
	});

	it("editSource returns own source", function() {
		var text = "* a\n** a1\n* b", m = build(text);
		expect(fmt.editSource(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"))).toBe("* a");
	});

	it("new item after subtree", function() {
		var text = "* a\n** a1\n* b", m = build(text),
			r = fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"), "x");
		expect(r.text).toBe("* a\n** a1\n* x\n* b");
		expect(r.select).toBe(10);
	});

	it("new item after last line", function() {
		var text = "* a", m = build(text), r = fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"), "x");
		expect(r.text).toBe("* a\n* x");
		expect(r.select).toBe(4);
	});

	it("new item: a typed leading marker equal to the item's marker is not doubled", function() {
		var text = "* a\n** a1\n* b", m = build(text);
		expect(fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"), "* foo").text).toBe("* a\n** a1\n* foo\n* b");
		expect(fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "** a1"), "**  deep").text).toBe("* a\n** a1\n** deep\n* b");
		// Other text that starts with marker characters stays
		expect(fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"), "*bold*").text).toBe("* a\n** a1\n* *bold*\n* b");
		expect(fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"), "** deeper").text).toBe("* a\n** a1\n* ** deeper\n* b");
		// Only the marker: nothing to insert
		expect(fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"), "*  ")).toBeNull();
	});
	it("new item keeps CRLF", function() {
		var text = "* a\r\n** a1\r\n* b", m = build(text),
			r = fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"), "x");
		expect(r.text).toBe("* a\r\n** a1\r\n* x\r\n* b");
		expect(r.text.replace(/\r\n/g, "")).not.toMatch(/[\r\n]/);
	});

	it("heading new paragraph", function() {
		var text = "! H\n\ntext", m = build(text),
			r = fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "! H"), "x");
		expect(r.text).toBe("! H\n\nx\n\ntext");
		expect(r.select).toBe(5);
	});

	it("heading new paragraph without blank line after", function() {
		var text = "! H\ntext", m = build(text),
			r = fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "! H"), "x");
		expect(r.text).toBe("! H\n\nx\n\ntext");
	});

	it("heading new paragraph at end of text", function() {
		var text = "! H", m = build(text), r = fmt.insertNew(text, m, 0, "x");
		expect(r.text).toBe("! H\n\nx");
	});

	it("block new paragraph", function() {
		var text = "para\n\nnext", m = build(text),
			r = fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "para"), "x");
		expect(r.text).toBe("para\n\nx\n\nnext");
		expect(r.select).toBe(6);
	});

	it("blank new unit", function() {
		var text = "* a", m = build(text);
		expect(fmt.insertNew(text, m, 0, "")).toBeNull();
		expect(fmt.insertNew(text, m, 0, "  \n ")).toBeNull();
	});

	it("heading new paragraph keeps trailing newline count", function() {
		var text = "! H\n", m = build(text), r = fmt.insertNew(text, m, 0, "x");
		expect(r.text).toBe("! H\n\nx\n");
	});

	it("isMultiline", function() {
		var t = "|a|b|\n\n```\nx\n```\n\n* a\n\n<$list filter=\"[all[]]\"/>\n\n<div>\n\npara\n\n</div>\n\npa\nrb",
			m = build(t);
		function find(tag, kind) {
			var u = unit(m, function(u) { return (tag && u.tag === tag) || (kind && u.kind === kind); });
			expect(u).toBeDefined();
			return u.id;
		}
		expect(fmt.isMultiline(m, find("table"))).toBe(true);
		expect(fmt.isMultiline(m, find("codeblock"))).toBe(true);
		expect(fmt.isMultiline(m, find(null, "widget"))).toBe(true);
		expect(fmt.isMultiline(m, find(null, "container"))).toBe(true);
		expect(fmt.isMultiline(m, idOf(m, "* a"))).toBe(false);
		var para = unit(m, function(u) { return m.text.substring(u.start, u.end) === "pa\nrb"; });
		expect(para).toBeDefined();
		expect(fmt.isMultiline(m, para.id)).toBe(true);
		var m2 = build(fixtures.NOTES.specialItems),
			multi = unit(m2, function(u) { return u.kind === "item" && /^\* """multi/.test(m2.text.substring(u.start, u.end)); });
		expect(multi).toBeDefined();
		expect(fmt.isMultiline(m2, multi.id)).toBe(true);
	});

	describe("remove", function() {
		function removed(text, source) {
			var m = build(text), r = fmt.remove(text, m, idOf(m, source));
			return r && r.text;
		}

		it("removes an item and one line break", function() {
			expect(removed("* a\n* b\n* c", "* b")).toBe("* a\n* c");
			expect(removed("* a\n* b", "* b")).toBe("* a");
			expect(removed("* a\n* b\n\npara", "* b")).toBe("* a\n\npara");
			expect(removed("* a\r\n* b\r\n* c", "* b")).toBe("* a\r\n* c");
		});

		it("keeps one blank-line separator between remaining blocks", function() {
			expect(removed("p1\n\np2\n\np3", "p2")).toBe("p1\n\np3");
			expect(removed("p1\n\np2", "p2")).toBe("p1");
			expect(removed("p1\n\np2", "p1")).toBe("p2");
			expect(removed("p1\r\n\r\np2\r\n\r\np3", "p2")).toBe("p1\r\n\r\np3");
		});

		it("refuses units with children", function() {
			var text = "* a\n** a1", m = build(text);
			expect(fmt.remove(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"))).toBe(null);
		});

		it("selects the place of the removed unit", function() {
			var text = "* a\n* b\n* c", m = build(text), r = fmt.remove(text, m, idOf(m, "* b"));
			expect(r.select).toBe(4);
		});
	});
});

title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/test-editor.js
type: application/javascript
tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]]

Tests for the in-place editor of the $outline widget (outline-editor.js): start, save, continue,
cancel, conflicts on outside changes, re-attach after re-render, editor keys and the transclusion jump.
Runs on the fake DOM (SimpleEngine). Typing is simulated by writing the buffer tiddler.

\*/
"use strict";

describe("outline editor", function() {

	var SEL = "$:/temp/rimir/outline/selection/",
		BUF = "$:/temp/rimir/outline/edit/",
		ON = "$:/state/rimir/outline/on/",
		EDITOR = "$:/plugins/rimir/outline/ui/editor",
		KEYS = {enter: 13, escape: 27};

	// Shortcut config and the editor template (shadows of the plugin) copied into each test wiki
	function pluginTiddlers() {
		return $tw.wiki.filterTiddlers("[all[shadows+tiddlers]prefix[$:/config/shortcuts/outline-]] [[" + EDITOR + "]]").map(function(title) {
			return $tw.wiki.getTiddler(title).fields;
		});
	}

	function makeWiki(tiddlers) {
		var wiki = new $tw.Wiki();
		wiki.addTiddlers(pluginTiddlers().concat(tiddlers || []));
		wiki.addIndexersToWiki();
		return wiki;
	}

	function findWidget(widget, type) {
		if(widget.parseTreeNode && widget.parseTreeNode.type === type) {
			return widget;
		}
		for(var i = 0; i < (widget.children || []).length; i++) {
			var found = findWidget(widget.children[i], type);
			if(found) {
				return found;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	function render(text, others) {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: text}].concat(others || []));
		var parser = wiki.parseText("text/vnd.tiddlywiki",
				"<$outline tiddler=\"T\"><$transclude $tiddler=\"T\" $mode=\"block\"/></$outline>",
				{parseAsInline: false}),
			root = wiki.makeWidget(parser, {document: $tw.fakeDocument}),
			container = $tw.fakeDocument.createElement("div");
		root.render(container, null);
		var r = {root: root, widget: findWidget(root, "outline"), wiki: wiki};
		r.refresh = function(extra) {
			var changes = {T: {modified: true}};
			changes[SEL + "T"] = {modified: true};
			changes[BUF + "T"] = {modified: true};
			$tw.utils.each(extra || [], function(t) { changes[t] = {modified: true}; });
			root.refresh(changes);
		};
		r.text = function() { return wiki.getTiddlerText("T"); };
		r.buffer = function() { return wiki.getTiddlerText(BUF + "T"); };
		r.type = function(value) { wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(wiki.getTiddler(BUF + "T"), {text: value})); };
		r.idOf = function(source) {
			var m = r.widget.model;
			for(var i = 0; i < m.units.length; i++) {
				if(m.text.substring(m.units[i].start, m.units[i].end) === source) {
					return i;
				}
			}
			throw new Error("no unit " + source);
		};
		return r;
	}

	// A second <$outline> view of T in the same wiki
	function secondView(r) {
		var parser = r.wiki.parseText("text/vnd.tiddlywiki",
				"<$outline tiddler=\"T\"><$transclude $tiddler=\"T\" $mode=\"block\"/></$outline>",
				{parseAsInline: false}),
			root = r.wiki.makeWidget(parser, {document: $tw.fakeDocument}),
			container = $tw.fakeDocument.createElement("div");
		root.render(container, null);
		return {root: root, widget: findWidget(root, "outline")};
	}

	function notes(r) {
		return elements(r.widget.editor.host).filter(function(el) { return hasClass(el, "rr-ol-notice"); });
	}

	function hasClass(el, cls) {
		return (el.attributes["class"] || "").split(" ").indexOf(cls) !== -1;
	}

	function siblings(node) {
		return node.parentNode.children;
	}

	function elements(node, out) {
		out = out || [];
		(node.children || []).forEach(function(child) {
			if(child.nodeType === 1) {
				out.push(child);
				elements(child, out);
			}
		});
		return out;
	}

	function editorKey(r, keyCode, mods) {
		mods = mods || {};
		var ev = {
			keyCode: keyCode,
			shiftKey: !!mods.shift, altKey: false, ctrlKey: !!mods.ctrl, metaKey: false,
			target: r.widget.editor.host,
			defaultPrevented: !!mods.defaultPrevented,
			prevented: false,
			preventDefault: function() { this.prevented = true; },
			stopPropagation: function() {}
		};
		r.widget.handleEditorKeydown(ev);
		return ev;
	}

	it("starts an edit next to the unit with the unit's own source", function() {
		var r = render("* a\n** a1\n* b");
		var id = r.idOf("* a"),
			li = r.widget.units[id].domNodes[0];
		expect(r.widget.startEdit(id)).toBe(true);
		var ed = r.widget.editor;
		expect(ed.id).toBe(id);
		expect(ed.isNew).toBe(false);
		expect(ed.origSource).toBe("* a");
		expect(ed.origStart).toBe(0);
		// Items: the host is the first child of the li; only the li's own content is hidden, not its sub-items
		expect(ed.host.tag).toBe("div");
		expect(hasClass(ed.host, "rr-ol-editor-host")).toBe(true);
		expect(ed.host.parentNode).toBe(li);
		expect(li.children[0]).toBe(ed.host);
		expect(hasClass(li, "rr-ol-editing-own")).toBe(true);
		expect(hasClass(li, "rr-ol-editing")).toBe(false);
		expect(r.buffer()).toBe("* a");
		// The editor template rendered an edit widget for the buffer
		var textareas = elements(ed.host).filter(function(el) { return el.tag === "textarea"; });
		expect(textareas.length).toBe(1);
		expect(textareas[0].textContent).toBe("* a");
	});

	it("uses a div host before non-items and hides them", function() {
		var r = render("! H\n\npara");
		var id = r.idOf("para"),
			p = r.widget.units[id].domNodes[0];
		r.widget.startEdit(id);
		expect(r.widget.editor.host.tag).toBe("div");
		expect(siblings(p).indexOf(r.widget.editor.host)).toBe(siblings(p).indexOf(p) - 1);
		expect(hasClass(p, "rr-ol-editing")).toBe(true);

"use strict";

var model = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js"),
	fmt = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/format-wikitext.js"),
	formats = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/formats.js"),
	fixtures = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/fixtures.js");

describe("outline indent/promote", function() {

	function build(text) { return model.buildModel($tw.wiki, text); }
	function idOf(m, s) {
		return m.units.filter(function(u) { return m.text.substring(u.start, u.end) === s; })[0].id;
	}
	function run(fn, text, s) {
		var m = build(text);
		return fn(text, m, idOf(m, s));
	}

	it("indent bullet", function() {
		var r = run(fmt.indent, "* a\n* b\n** b1", "* b");
		expect(r.text).toBe("* a\n** b\n*** b1");
		expect(r.select).toBe(4);
	});
	it("indent numbered", function() {
		expect(run(fmt.indent, "# a\n# b", "# b").text).toBe("# a\n## b");
	});
	it("indent mixed", function() {
		expect(run(fmt.indent, "# x\n#* a\n#* b", "#* b").text).toBe("# x\n#* a\n#** b");
	});
	it("indent uses the item's own char for descendants", function() {
		expect(run(fmt.indent, "#* a\n#* b\n#** b1", "#* b").text).toBe("#* a\n#** b\n#*** b1");
	});
	it("no previous sibling", function() {
		expect(run(fmt.indent, "* a\n* b", "* a")).toBe(null);
	});
	it("promote at depth 1", function() {
		expect(run(fmt.promote, "* a\n* b", "* b")).toBe(null);
	});
	it("promote captures following siblings", function() {
		expect(run(fmt.promote, "* a\n** b\n** c", "** b").text).toBe("* a\n* b\n** c");
	});
	it("heading section", function() {
		expect(run(fmt.indent, "! A\n\ntext\n\n!! B", "! A").text).toBe("!! A\n\ntext\n\n!!! B");
	});
	it("heading promote", function() {
		expect(run(fmt.promote, "!! A\n\n!!! B", "!! A").text).toBe("! A\n\n!! B");
		expect(run(fmt.promote, "! A", "! A")).toBe(null);
	});
	it("heading limit", function() {
		expect(run(fmt.indent, "!! A\n\n!!!!!! B", "!! A")).toBe(null);
	});
	it("class item", function() {
		expect(run(fmt.indent, "* a\n*.cls b", "*.cls b").text).toBe("* a\n**.cls b");
	});
	it("other kinds are null", function() {
		var m = build("para\n\n* a");
		expect(fmt.indent("para\n\n* a", m, 0)).toBe(null);
		expect(fmt.promote("para\n\n* a", m, 0)).toBe(null);
	});
	it("indent keeps CRLF", function() {
		var t = fixtures.NOTES.crlf, m = build(t),
			r = fmt.indent(t, m, idOf(m, "* four"));
		expect(r.text.replace(/\r\n/g, "").indexOf("\n")).toBe(-1);
		expect(r.text.split("\r\n").length).toBe(t.split("\r\n").length);
	});
	it("getFormat", function() {
		expect(formats.getFormat("text/vnd.tiddlywiki")).toBeTruthy();
		expect(formats.getFormat("")).toBeTruthy();
		expect(formats.getFormat("text/x-markdown")).toBe(null);
	});
	it("post-op guard refuses a changed unit count and level jumps other than one", function() {
		var t = "* a\n* b\n** b1\n* c", m = build(t), b = idOf(m, "* b");
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, b, "indent", "* a\n** b\n*** b1\n* c")).toBe(true);
		// The subtree stayed behind
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, b, "indent", "* a\n** b\n** b1\n* c")).toBe(false);
		// Two levels
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, b, "indent", "* a\n*** b\n**** b1\n* c")).toBe(false);
		// A unit outside the subtree changed
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, b, "indent", "* a\n** b\n*** b1\n** c")).toBe(false);
		// Unit count changed
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, b, "indent", "* a\n** b\n*** b1\n\npara")).toBe(false);
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, b, "promote", "* a\nb\n* b1\n* c")).toBe(false);
		var h = "! A\n\n!! B\n\nx", mh = build(h);
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, mh, idOf(mh, "!! B"), "promote", "! A\n\n! B\n\nx")).toBe(true);
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, mh, idOf(mh, "!! B"), "indent", "! A\n\n!!!! B\n\nx")).toBe(false);
	});
	it("round trip and range", function() {
		Object.keys(fixtures.NOTES).forEach(function(name) {
			var t = fixtures.NOTES[name], m = build(t);
			m.units.forEach(function(u) {
				if(u.kind !== "item" && u.kind !== "heading") { return; }
				var r = fmt.indent(t, m, u.id);
				if(!r) { return; }
				fixtures.assertOnlyRangesChanged(t, r.text, [[u.start, u.subtreeEnd]], expect);
				expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, u.id, "indent", r.text)).withContext(name + " " + u.id).toBe(true);
				var m2 = build(r.text), nid = m2.units.filter(function(x) { return x.start === r.select; })[0].id,
					back = fmt.promote(r.text, m2, nid);
				expect(back && back.text).toBe(t);
				expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m2, nid, "promote", back.text)).withContext(name + " " + u.id).toBe(true);
			});
		});
	});
});

title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/test-keys.js
type: application/javascript
tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]]

Tests for selection, configurable keys and structural operations of the $outline widget.

\*/
"use strict";

describe("outline selection and keys", function() {

	var SEL = "$:/temp/rimir/outline/selection/",
		KEYS = {up: 38, down: 40, tab: 9, escape: 27, enter: 13};

	// Shortcut config (shadows of the plugin) copied into each test wiki
	function shortcutTiddlers() {
		return $tw.wiki.filterTiddlers("[all[shadows+tiddlers]prefix[$:/config/shortcuts/outline-]]").map(function(title) {
			return $tw.wiki.getTiddler(title).fields;
		});
	}

	function makeWiki(tiddlers) {
		var wiki = new $tw.Wiki();
		wiki.addTiddlers(shortcutTiddlers().concat(tiddlers || []));
		wiki.addIndexersToWiki();
		return wiki;
	}

	function findWidget(widget, type) {
		if(widget.parseTreeNode && widget.parseTreeNode.type === type) {
			return widget;
		}
		for(var i = 0; i < (widget.children || []).length; i++) {
			var found = findWidget(widget.children[i], type);
			if(found) {
				return found;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	function renderOutline(wiki, title) {
		var parser = wiki.parseText("text/vnd.tiddlywiki",
				"<$outline tiddler=\"" + title + "\"><$transclude $tiddler=\"" + title + "\" $mode=\"block\"/></$outline>",
				{parseAsInline: false}),
			root = wiki.makeWidget(parser, {document: $tw.fakeDocument}),
			container = $tw.fakeDocument.createElement("div");
		root.render(container, null);
		var r = {root: root, widget: findWidget(root, "outline"), wiki: wiki, title: title};
		// Re-render like the browser does after a change event
		r.refresh = function() {
			var changes = {};
			changes[title] = {modified: true};
			changes[SEL + title] = {modified: true};
			root.refresh(changes);
		};
		return r;
	}

	function key(r, keyCode, mods) {
		mods = mods || {};
		var ev = {
			keyCode: keyCode,
			shiftKey: !!mods.shift, altKey: !!mods.alt, ctrlKey: !!mods.ctrl, metaKey: false,
			target: mods.target || r.widget.domNode,
			defaultPrevented: !!mods.defaultPrevented,
			prevented: false,
			stopped: false,
			preventDefault: function() { this.prevented = true; },
			stopPropagation: function() { this.stopped = true; }
		};
		r.widget.handleKeydown(ev);
		return ev;
	}

	function hasClass(el, cls) {
		return (el.attributes["class"] || "").split(" ").indexOf(cls) !== -1;
	}

	function selectedUnit(r) {
		var id = r.widget.selectedId;
		return id === -1 ? null : r.widget.units[id].unit;
	}

	function selectedSource(r) {
		var u = selectedUnit(r);
		return u ? r.widget.model.text.substring(u.start, u.end) : null;
	}

	function idOf(r, source) {
		var m = r.widget.model;
		for(var i = 0; i < m.units.length; i++) {
			if(m.text.substring(m.units[i].start, m.units[i].end) === source) {
				return i;
			}
		}
		return -1;
	}

	it("ships configurable default keys", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki(),
			expected = {
				"outline-up": "Up", "outline-down": "Down", "outline-move-up": "alt-Up", "outline-move-down": "alt-Down",
				"outline-indent": "Tab", "outline-promote": "shift-Tab", "outline-edit": "shift-Enter",
				"outline-open": "Enter", "outline-clear": "Escape", "outline-save": "ctrl-Enter",
				"outline-continue": "Enter", "outline-newline": "shift-Enter", "outline-cancel": "Escape"
			};
		Object.keys(expected).forEach(function(name) {
			expect(name + "=" + wiki.getTiddlerText("$:/config/shortcuts/" + name)).toBe(name + "=" + expected[name]);
			expect($tw.wiki.getTiddlerText("$:/config/ShortcutInfo/" + name)).toBeTruthy();
		});
		var up = $tw.keyboardManager.parseKeyDescriptors("((outline-move-up))", {wiki: wiki});
		expect(up[0].keyCode).toBe(38);
		expect(up[0].altKey).toBe(true);
	});

	it("select marks the unit and saves the selection", function() {
		var r = renderOutline(makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b"}]), "T");
		expect(r.widget.select(2)).toBe(true);
		expect(r.widget.selectedId).toBe(2);
		expect(hasClass(r.widget.units[2].domNodes[0], "rr-ol-selected")).toBe(true);
		var state = r.wiki.getTiddler(SEL + "T");
		expect(state.fields.start).toBe("4");
		expect(state.fields.index).toBe("2");
		r.widget.select(1);
		expect(hasClass(r.widget.units[2].domNodes[0], "rr-ol-selected")).toBe(false);
		expect(hasClass(r.widget.units[1].domNodes[0], "rr-ol-selected")).toBe(true);
	});

	it("arrows move in document order and skip units without DOM nodes", function() {
		var r = renderOutline(makeWiki([
			{title: "T", text: "* a\n\n<$list filter=\"x\">\n\n<$text text=\"t\"/>\n\n</$list>\n\npara"}
		]), "T");
		var listWidget = r.widget.units[2];
		expect(listWidget.unit.kind).toBe("widget");
		expect(listWidget.domNodes.length).toBe(0);
		// Down without a selection selects the first unit
		var ev = key(r, KEYS.down);
		expect(ev.prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(ev.stopped).toBe(true);
		expect(r.widget.selectedId).toBe(0);
		key(r, KEYS.down);
		expect(r.widget.selectedId).toBe(1);
		key(r, KEYS.down);
		expect(selectedSource(r)).toBe("para");
		key(r, KEYS.down);
		expect(selectedSource(r)).toBe("para");
		key(r, KEYS.up);
		expect(r.widget.selectedId).toBe(1);
		r.widget.select(2);
		expect(r.widget.selectedId).toBe(1);
	});

	it("escape clears, events already handled are ignored", function() {
		var r = renderOutline(makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b"}]), "T");
		r.widget.select(1);
		var ev = key(r, KEYS.down, {defaultPrevented: true});
		expect(ev.stopped).toBe(false);
		expect(r.widget.selectedId).toBe(1);
		ev = key(r, KEYS.escape);
		expect(ev.prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(r.widget.selectedId).toBe(-1);
		expect(r.wiki.tiddlerExists(SEL + "T")).toBe(false);
		// Without a selection Escape and Tab pass through
		expect(key(r, KEYS.escape).prevented).toBe(false);
		expect(key(r, KEYS.tab).prevented).toBe(false);
	});

	it("selection follows moved unit", function() {
		var r = renderOutline(makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b"}]), "T");
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* b"));
		var ev = key(r, KEYS.up, {alt: true});
		expect(ev.prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(r.wiki.getTiddlerText("T")).toBe("* b\n* a");
		r.refresh();
		// The list and the moved item both start at 0: the item stays selected
		expect(selectedUnit(r).kind).toBe("item");
		expect(selectedSource(r)).toBe("* b");
		expect(hasClass(r.widget.units[r.widget.selectedId].domNodes[0], "rr-ol-selected")).toBe(true);
	});

	it("applyResult writes once and saves the selection", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n** b", tags: "X", custom: "c"}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"),
			writes = 0,
			addTiddler = wiki.addTiddler;
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "** b"));
		wiki.addTiddler = function(t) {
			if(t.fields && t.fields.title === "T") {
				writes++;
			}
			return addTiddler.apply(this, arguments);
		};
		key(r, KEYS.tab, {shift: true});
		expect(writes).toBe(1);
		var t = wiki.getTiddler("T");
		expect(t.fields.text).toBe("* a\n* b");
		expect(t.fields.custom).toBe("c");
		expect(t.fields.tags).toEqual(["X"]);
		expect($tw.utils.isDate(t.fields.modified)).toBe(true);
		expect(wiki.getTiddler(SEL + "T").fields.start).toBe("4");
		r.refresh();
		expect(selectedSource(r)).toBe("* b");
	});

	it("indent carries the subtree, heading indent carries the section", function() {
		var r = renderOutline(makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b\n** b1"}]), "T");
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* b"));
		key(r, KEYS.tab);
		expect(r.wiki.getTiddlerText("T")).toBe("* a\n** b\n*** b1");
		var h = renderOutline(makeWiki([{title: "H", text: "! H\n\npara\n\n!! S\n\n! I"}]), "H");
		h.widget.select(0);
		key(h, KEYS.tab);
		expect(h.wiki.getTiddlerText("H")).toBe("!! H\n\npara\n\n!!! S\n\n! I");
		h.refresh();
		expect(selectedSource(h)).toBe("!! H");
	});

	it("edge no-op does not write but keeps the key", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b"}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"),
			before = wiki.getTiddler("T");
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* a"));
		expect(key(r, KEYS.up, {alt: true}).prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(key(r, KEYS.tab).prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(key(r, KEYS.tab, {shift: true}).prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(wiki.getTiddler("T")).toBe(before);
	});

	it("identical result text does not write but the frame follows", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* a"}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"),
			before = wiki.getTiddler("T");
		r.widget.select(2);
		expect(key(r, KEYS.up, {alt: true}).prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(wiki.getTiddler("T")).toBe(before);
		expect(wiki.getTiddler(SEL + "T").fields.start).toBe("0");
		r.refresh();
		expect(selectedUnit(r).kind).toBe("item");
		expect(selectedUnit(r).start).toBe(0);
	});

	it("refuses (no write) an adapter result that changes the units", function() {
		var fmt = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/format-wikitext.js"),
			wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b\npara"}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"),
			before = wiki.getTiddler("T");
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "para"));
		spyOn(fmt, "move").and.returnValue({text: "para\n* a\n* b", select: 0});
		expect(key(r, KEYS.up, {alt: true}).prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(fmt.move).toHaveBeenCalled();
		expect(wiki.getTiddler("T")).toBe(before);
		spyOn(fmt, "indent").and.returnValue({text: "* a\n*** b\npara", select: 4});
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* b"));
		expect(key(r, KEYS.tab).prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(wiki.getTiddler("T")).toBe(before);
	});

	it("read-only allows selection only", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b"}, {title: "$:/status/IsReadOnly", text: "yes"}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"),
			before = wiki.getTiddler("T");
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* b"));
		// Tab is still consumed: it must not move the focus while a unit is selected
		expect(key(r, KEYS.tab).prevented).toBe(true);
		key(r, KEYS.up, {alt: true});
		key(r, KEYS.tab, {shift: true});
		expect(wiki.getTiddler("T")).toBe(before);
		key(r, KEYS.up);
		expect(selectedSource(r)).toBe("* a");
		key(r, KEYS.escape);
		expect(r.widget.selectedId).toBe(-1);
	});

	it("stale model does nothing and rebuilds", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b"}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T");
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* b"));
		var domNode = r.widget.domNode;
		// Outside change that has not been rendered yet
		wiki.addTiddler({title: "T", text: "* a\n* b\n* c"});
		var changed = wiki.getTiddler("T");
		key(r, KEYS.up, {alt: true});
		expect(wiki.getTiddler("T")).toBe(changed);
		expect(r.widget.model.text).toBe("* a\n* b\n* c");
		expect(r.widget.units.length).toBe(4);
		expect(r.widget.domNode).toBe(domNode);
		expect(selectedSource(r)).toBe("* b");
	});

	it("keys pressed before the refresh after our own write still act (no refresh in between)", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b\n* c\n* d"}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T");
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* a"));
		key(r, KEYS.down, {alt: true});
		expect(wiki.getTiddlerText("T")).toBe("* b\n* a\n* c\n* d");
		key(r, KEYS.down, {alt: true});
		expect(wiki.getTiddlerText("T")).toBe("* b\n* c\n* a\n* d");
		// Down right after a write steps from the moved unit in the new text
		key(r, KEYS.down);
		expect(selectedSource(r)).toBe("* d");
		key(r, KEYS.up, {alt: true});
		expect(wiki.getTiddlerText("T")).toBe("* b\n* c\n* d\n* a");
	});

	it("structural keys do nothing while this view has an open editor", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b\n* c"}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"),
			before = wiki.getTiddler("T");
		r.widget.startEdit(idOf(r, "* b"));
		expect(r.widget.editor).not.toBe(null);
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* c"));
		expect(key(r, KEYS.up, {alt: true}).prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(key(r, KEYS.tab).prevented).toBe(true);
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* a"));
		expect(key(r, KEYS.down, {alt: true}).prevented).toBe(true);
		expect(wiki.getTiddler("T")).toBe(before);
	});

	it("re-selects by start, else by clamped index", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b\n* c"}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T");
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* c"));
		wiki.addTiddler({title: "T", text: "* a"});
		r.refresh();
		expect(selectedSource(r)).toBe("* a");
		wiki.addTiddler({title: "T", text: "para\n\n* x\n* y\n* z"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: SEL + "T", start: "999", index: "2"});
		r.refresh();
		expect(selectedSource(r)).toBe("* x");
	});

	it("outline-open acts only on a transclusion unit", function() {
		var r = renderOutline(makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n\n{{X}}"}, {title: "X", text: "! x"}]), "T");
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "* a"));
		expect(key(r, KEYS.enter).prevented).toBe(false);
		r.widget.select(idOf(r, "{{X}}"));
		expect(key(r, KEYS.enter).prevented).toBe(true);
	});

	it("ignores keys from elements inside the container", function() {
		var r = renderOutline(makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b"}]), "T");
		r.widget.select(1);
		var input = $tw.fakeDocument.createElement("input");
		expect(key(r, KEYS.down, {target: input}).prevented).toBe(false);
		expect(r.widget.selectedId).toBe(1);
	});
});

title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/test-model.js
type: application/javascript
tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]]

Tests for model.js (unit list with kinds, levels, parents and subtree ranges).

\*/
"use strict";

var model = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js"),
	fixtures = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/fixtures.js");

describe("outline model", function() {

	function build(text, title) {
		return model.buildModel($tw.wiki, text, title);
	}
	function src(m, u) {
		return m.text.substring(u.start, u.end);
	}
	function byText(m, s) {
		return m.units.filter(function(u) { return src(m, u) === s; })[0];
	}

	it("simple list", function() {
		var m = build("* a\n** b\n* c");
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["list:0:-1", "item:1:0", "item:2:1", "item:1:0"]);
		expect(m.units[1].subtreeEnd).toBe(8);
		expect(m.units[1].end).toBe(3);
		expect(m.units[1].marker).toBe("*");
		expect(m.units[2].marker).toBe("**");
		expect(m.units[1].children).toEqual([2]);
		expect(m.units[0].children).toEqual([1, 3]);
		expect(m.units[0].subtreeEnd).toBe(12);
		expect(m.units[0].end).toBe(12);
		expect(m.units[3].subtreeEnd).toBe(12);
		expect(m.roots).toEqual([0]);
		expect(m.units[1].tag).toBe("li");
		expect(m.units[0].tag).toBe("ul");
	});

	it("list range covers nested items of its last item", function() {
		var m = build("* x\n** y");
		expect(m.units[0].end).toBe(8);
		expect(m.units[0].end).toBe(m.units[0].subtreeEnd);
		m = build("; t\n: d\n;; u");
		expect(m.units[0].kind).toBe("list");
		expect(src(m, m.units[0])).toBe("; t\n: d\n;; u");
		expect(m.units[0].end).toBe(m.units[0].subtreeEnd);
		m = build("! H\n\n* x\n** y\n\n! I");
		expect(src(m, m.units[1])).toBe("* x\n** y");
		expect(m.units[1].end).toBe(m.units[1].subtreeEnd);
	});

	it("headings with sections", function() {
		var text = "! A\n\np1\n\n!! B\n\np2\n\n! C",
			m = build(text);
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual([
			"heading:1:-1", "block:0:0", "heading:2:0", "block:0:2", "heading:1:-1"
		]);
		var A = m.units[0], p1 = m.units[1], B = m.units[2], p2 = m.units[3], C = m.units[4];
		expect(A.subtreeEnd).toBe(p2.end);
		expect(p2.end).toBe(17);
		expect(B.subtreeEnd).toBe(17);
		expect(C.subtreeEnd).toBe(text.length);
		expect(p1.parent).toBe(A.id);
		expect(A.children).toEqual([1, 2]);
		expect(m.roots).toEqual([0, 4]);
		expect(A.tag).toBe("h1");
		expect(B.tag).toBe("h2");
		expect(p1.tag).toBe("p");
	});

	it("content before first heading", function() {
		var m = build("intro\n\n! A");
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["block:0:-1", "heading:1:-1"]);
		expect(m.units[0].children).toEqual([]);
	});

	it("transclusion", function() {
		var m = build("{{X}}");
		expect(m.units.length).toBe(1);
		expect(m.units[0].kind).toBe("transclusion");
		expect(m.units[0].target).toBe("X");
		m = build("{{X||T}}");
		expect(m.units[0].kind).toBe("transclusion");
		expect(m.units[0].target).toBe("X");
		m = build("<<m>>");
		expect(m.units[0].kind).toBe("widget");
		expect(m.units[0].target).toBe(null);
	});

	it("transclusion: newline excluded from the unit range", function() {
		var m = build("{{X}}\n\npara");
		expect(m.units[0].start).toBe(0);
		expect(m.units[0].end).toBe(5);
	});

	it("transclusion: widget forms", function() {
		var m = build("<$transclude $tiddler=X/>\n\n<$transclude tiddler=Y/>\n\n<$transclude $tiddler={{a}}/>\n\n<$transclude $tiddler=\"\"/>\n");
		expect(m.units.map(function(u) { return u.kind + ":" + u.target; })).toEqual([
			"transclusion:X", "transclusion:Y", "widget:null", "widget:null"
		]);
	});

	it("transclusion of the tiddler itself or of a field is a widget", function() {
		expect(build("{{Me}}\n", "Me").units[0].kind).toBe("widget");
		expect(build("{{!!f}}\n").units[0].kind).toBe("widget");
		var m = build("{{X!!f}}\n");
		expect(m.units[0].kind).toBe("transclusion");
		expect(m.units[0].target).toBe("X");
	});

	it("container opened", function() {
		var m = build("<div>\n\n* a\n\n</div>");
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["container:0:-1", "list:0:0", "item:1:1"]);
		expect(m.units[0].tag).toBe("div");
		expect(m.units[0].end).toBe(18);
		expect(m.units[0].subtreeEnd).toBe(18);
	});

	it("container with headings: heading parent is the container", function() {
		var m = build(fixtures.NOTES.container);
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual([
			"block:0:-1", "container:0:-1", "heading:1:1", "list:0:2", "item:1:3", "item:1:3", "block:0:2",
			"list:0:-1", "item:1:7"
		]);
		expect(m.units[2].subtreeEnd).toBe(m.units[6].end);
	});

	it("html element without block content is a block; widgets are not opened", function() {
		var m = build("<div>inline</div>\n\n<$list filter=x>\n\n* a\n\n</$list>");
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["block:0:-1", "widget:0:-1"]);
		expect(m.units[1].tag).toBe("list");
	});

	it("pragmas skipped", function() {
		var m = build("\\procedure p() x\n\n* a");
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["list:0:-1", "item:1:0"]);
		expect(m.units[1].start).toBe(18);
		expect(m.text.charAt(m.units[1].start)).toBe("*");
	});

	it("stacked pragmas skipped, <$set> widget is not a pragma", function() {
		var m = build("\\import [[x]]\n\\rules except dash\n\\parameters (a)\n\\whitespace trim\n\n<<m>>\n\n<$set name=a value=b>\n\nx\n\n</$set>");
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["widget:0:-1", "widget:0:-1"]);
		expect(m.units[1].tag).toBe("set");
	});

	it("empty and pragma-only text", function() {
		expect(build("").units.length).toBe(0);
		expect(build("\\whitespace trim").units.length).toBe(0);
		expect(build(fixtures.NOTES.pragmaOnly).units.length).toBe(0);
		expect(build("").roots).toEqual([]);
	});

	it("subtree ranges with CRLF", function() {
		var text = "* a\r\n** b\r\n* c",
			m = build(text);
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["list:0:-1", "item:1:0", "item:2:1", "item:1:0"]);
		expect(m.units[1].subtreeEnd).toBe(9);
		expect(text.substring(m.units[1].start, m.units[1].subtreeEnd)).toBe("* a\r\n** b");
		expect(m.units[1].end).toBe(3);
	});

	it("CRLF: block ends exclude the line break", function() {
		var m = build(fixtures.NOTES.crlf);
		m.units.forEach(function(u) {
			expect(/[\r\n]$/.test(src(m, u))).toBe(false);
		});
		expect(src(m, m.units[m.units.length - 1])).toBe("Final paragraph.");
	});

	it("multi-line item", function() {
		var m = build(fixtures.NOTES.specialItems),
			item = byText(m, "* \"\"\"multi\nline item\"\"\"");
		expect(item).toBeDefined();
		expect(item.kind).toBe("item");
		expect(m.text.substring(item.end - 3, item.end)).toBe("\"\"\"");
		expect(m.text.charAt(item.end)).toBe("\n");
	});

	it("classed items: marker stops at the class", function() {
		var m = build(fixtures.NOTES.specialItems);
		var cls = byText(m, "*.cls classed item");
		expect(cls.marker).toBe("*");
		expect(cls.level).toBe(1);
		expect(m.units[cls.children[0]].marker).toBe("**");
	});

	it("mixed markers, definition lists and blockquotes", function() {
		var m = build(fixtures.NOTES.mixedMarkers);
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual([
			"list:0:-1", "item:1:0", "item:2:1", "item:2:1", "item:3:3", "item:1:0",
			"list:0:-1", "item:1:6", "item:1:6", "item:1:6", "item:1:6",
			"list:0:-1", "item:1:11", "item:1:11",
			"list:0:-1", "item:1:14", "item:2:15", "item:1:14"
		]);
		expect(m.units[4].marker).toBe("*#*");
		expect(m.units[1].subtreeEnd).toBe(m.units[4].end);
		expect(m.units[7].marker).toBe(";");
		expect(m.units[8].marker).toBe(":");
		expect(m.units[12].marker).toBe(">");
		expect(m.units[12].tag).toBe("div");
		expect(m.units[11].tag).toBe("blockquote");
	});

	it("skipped list levels: no phantom item, list subtree covers all items", function() {
		var text = "* a\n*** c\n*** d",
			m = build(text);
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["list:0:-1", "item:1:0", "item:3:1", "item:3:1"]);
		expect(m.units[2].start).toBe(4);
		expect(m.units[2].end).toBe(9);
		expect(m.units[0].subtreeEnd).toBe(text.length);
		expect(m.units[1].subtreeEnd).toBe(text.length);
	});

	it("blocks fixture: kinds, tags and targets", function() {
		var m = build(fixtures.NOTES.blocks);
		expect(m.units.map(function(u) { return u.kind + ":" + u.tag + ":" + u.parent; })).toEqual([
			"heading:h1:-1", "block:codeblock:0", "block:table:0", "transclusion:tiddler:0",
			"transclusion:tiddler:0", "widget:transclude:0", "widget:list:0", "block:p:0"
		]);
		expect(m.units[3].target).toBe("Some Tiddler");
		expect(m.units[4].target).toBe("Some Tiddler");
		expect(src(m, m.units[2])).toBe("|!Name |!Value |\n|alpha |1 |\n|beta |2 |");
		expect(src(m, m.units[7])).toBe("After the blocks.");
	});

	it("typed block starts at its $$$ header line; comments are not units", function() {
		var text = "<!-- c -->\n\n$$$text/plain\nx\n$$$\n\n---\n",
			m = build(text);
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["block:0:-1", "block:0:-1"]);
		expect(src(m, m.units[0])).toBe("$$$text/plain\nx\n$$$");
		expect(src(m, m.units[1])).toBe("---");
	});

	it("comment between blocks is not a unit", function() {
		var m = build("para\n\n<!-- c -->\n\n---");
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["block:0:-1", "block:0:-1"]);
		expect(m.units[1].tag).toBe("hr");
	});

	it("styled block is one opaque block", function() {
		var m = build("@@.cls\n* a\n@@\n\npara");
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(m)).toEqual(["block:0:-1", "block:0:-1"]);
		expect(src(m, m.units[0])).toBe("@@.cls\n* a\n@@");
	});

	it("corpus: every fixture builds a consistent model", function() {
		Object.keys(fixtures.NOTES).forEach(function(name) {
			var text = fixtures.NOTES[name], m;
			expect(function() { m = build(text); }).not.toThrow();
			expect(m.text).toBe(text);
			var lastStart = -1;
			m.units.forEach(function(u, i) {
				expect(u.id).withContext(name + " id").toBe(i);
				expect(u.start).withContext(name + " order").not.toBeLessThan(lastStart);
				lastStart = u.start;
				expect(u.start < u.end).withContext(name + " range " + i).toBe(true);
				expect(u.end <= u.subtreeEnd).withContext(name + " subtreeEnd " + i).toBe(true);
				expect(u.subtreeEnd <= text.length).toBe(true);
				if(u.parent === -1) {
					expect(m.roots).toContain(i);
				} else {
					var p = m.units[u.parent];
					expect(u.parent < i).withContext(name + " parent first " + i).toBe(true);
					expect(p.children).toContain(i);
					expect(u.start >= p.start && u.subtreeEnd <= p.subtreeEnd)
						.withContext(name + " inside parent " + i).toBe(true);
				}
				u.children.forEach(function(c) { expect(m.units[c].parent).toBe(i); });
			});
		});
	});

	it("corpus: units per fixture", function() {
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(build(fixtures.NOTES.nestedLists))).toEqual([
			"heading:1:-1", "list:0:0", "item:1:1", "item:2:2", "item:3:3", "item:3:3", "item:4:5",
			"item:2:2", "item:1:1", "item:2:8", "item:1:1"
		]);
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(build(fixtures.NOTES.headings))).toEqual([
			"heading:1:-1", "block:0:0", "heading:2:0", "list:0:2", "item:1:3", "item:1:3",
			"heading:3:2", "block:0:6", "list:0:6", "item:1:8", "item:2:9",
			"heading:2:0", "block:0:11", "heading:1:-1", "block:0:13"
		]);
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(build(fixtures.NOTES.procedure))).toEqual([
			"heading:1:-1", "list:0:0", "item:1:1", "item:2:2", "item:1:1"
		]);
		expect(fixtures.unitSignature(build(fixtures.NOTES.noTrailingNewline))).toEqual([
			"heading:1:-1", "list:0:0", "item:1:1", "item:1:1"
		]);
	});
});

title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/test-move.js
type: application/javascript
tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]]

Tests for move in format-wikitext.js.

\*/
"use strict";

var model = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js"),
	fmt = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/format-wikitext.js"),
	fixtures = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/fixtures.js");

describe("outline move", function() {

	function build(text) { return model.buildModel($tw.wiki, text); }
	function idOf(m, s) {
		return m.units.filter(function(u) { return m.text.substring(u.start, u.end) === s; })[0].id;
	}
	function run(text, s, dir) {
		var m = build(text);
		return fmt.move(text, m, idOf(m, s), dir);
	}

	it("items with children", function() {
		var r = run("* a\n** a1\n* b\n** b1", "* b", -1);
		expect(r.text).toBe("* b\n** b1\n* a\n** a1");
		expect(r.select).toBe(0);
		var r2 = run("* a\n** a1\n* b\n** b1", "* a", 1);
		expect(r2.text).toBe("* b\n** b1\n* a\n** a1");
		expect(r2.select).toBe(10);
	});
	it("headings with sections", function() {
		expect(run("! A\n\nx\n\n! B\n\ny", "! B", -1).text).toBe("! B\n\ny\n\n! A\n\nx");
	});
	it("blocks in section", function() {
		expect(run("! H\n\np1\n\np2\n", "p2", -1).text).toBe("! H\n\np2\n\np1\n");
	});
	it("edge no-ops", function() {
		expect(run("* a\n* b", "* a", -1)).toBe(null);
		expect(run("* a\n* b", "* b", 1)).toBe(null);
		expect(run("! H\n\np\n\n!! S\n\nq", "p", 1)).toBe(null);
		expect(run("* a\n* b\n\np", "* b", 1)).toBe(null);
		expect(run("intro\n\n! H\n\nx", "intro", 1)).toBe(null);
		expect(run("intro\n\n! H\n\nx", "! H", -1)).toBe(null);
		expect(run("! P\n\n!!! c\n\n!! d", "!! d", -1)).toBe(null);
		expect(run("* a\n*** c\n** d", "** d", -1)).toBe(null);
	});
	it("container", function() {
		var t = "<div>\n\np1\n\np2\n\n</div>";
		expect(run(t, "p1", 1).text).toBe("<div>\n\np2\n\np1\n\n</div>");
		expect(run(t, "p2", 1)).toBe(null);
	});
	it("container moves as a whole", function() {
		var t = "<div>\n\np1\n\n</div>\n\nafter";
		expect(run(t, "after", -1).text).toBe("after\n\n<div>\n\np1\n\n</div>");
	});
	it("move last unit without trailing newline", function() {
		expect(run("p1\n\np2", "p2", -1).text).toBe("p2\n\np1");
		expect(run("* a\n* b", "* b", -1).text).toBe("* b\n* a");
	});
	it("keeps CRLF", function() {
		var t = "* one\r\n* two\r\n\r\np", m = build(t);
		expect(fmt.move(t, m, idOf(m, "* two"), -1).text).toBe("* two\r\n* one\r\n\r\np");
		var t2 = "a\r\n\r\nb\r\n", m2 = build(t2);
		expect(fmt.move(t2, m2, idOf(m2, "b"), -1).text).toBe("b\r\n\r\na\r\n");
	});
	it("blocks that touch (single line break) are swapped with a blank-line separator", function() {
		expect(run("* a\n* b\npara", "para", -1).text).toBe("para\n\n* a\n* b");
		expect(run("para\n\n* a\n* b\nend", "* a\n* b", 1).text).toBe("para\n\nend\n\n* a\n* b");
		expect(run("```\ncode\n```\npara", "para", -1).text).toBe("para\n\n```\ncode\n```");
		expect(run("|a |\n|b |\npara", "para", -1).text).toBe("para\n\n|a |\n|b |");
		// ...and before the content after the pair
		expect(run("para\n\n* a\n* b\nend", "para", 1).text).toBe("* a\n* b\n\npara\n\nend");
		var t = "* a\r\n* b\r\npara", m = build(t);
		expect(fmt.move(t, m, idOf(m, "para"), -1).text).toBe("para\r\n\r\n* a\r\n* b");
		// A comment between the blocks is kept, never deleted
		expect(run("* a\n* b\n<!-- keep me -->\npara two", "para two", -1).text).toBe("para two\n\n<!-- keep me -->\n\n* a\n* b");
		expect(run("```\ncode\n```\n<!-- c -->\npara", "para", -1).text).toBe("para\n\n<!-- c -->\n\n```\ncode\n```");
		// The line after the pair keeps its indentation
		expect(run("para\n\n```\nx\n```\n  next", "para", 1).text).toBe("```\nx\n```\n\npara\n\n  next");
		// Items and headings keep their single line break
		expect(run("* a\n* b", "* b", -1).text).toBe("* b\n* a");
		expect(run("! A\n! B", "! B", -1).text).toBe("! B\n! A");
	});
	it("post-op guard refuses a move that changes the units", function() {
		var t = "* a\n* b\npara", m = build(t), p = idOf(m, "para");
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, p, "move", "para\n\n* a\n* b")).toBe(true);
		// The old separator-keeping swap merged everything into one paragraph
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, p, "move", "para\n* a\n* b")).toBe(false);
		// Same count, other kinds
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, p, "move", "para\n\n* a\n\n```\nx\n```")).toBe(false);
		// A move never changes levels
		expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, p, "move", "para\n\n* a\n** b")).toBe(false);
	});
	it("touching blocks keep their units after a move", function() {
		["* a\n* b\npara", "para\n\n* a\n* b\nend", "```\ncode\n```\npara"].forEach(function(t) {
			var m = build(t);
			m.units.forEach(function(u) {
				[1, -1].forEach(function(dir) {
					var r = fmt.move(t, m, u.id, dir);
					if(r) {
						expect(build(r.text).units.length).withContext(JSON.stringify(t) + " " + u.id + " " + dir).toBe(m.units.length);
					}
				});
			});
		});
	});
	it("round trip and invariants over the corpus", function() {
		var moved = 0;
		Object.keys(fixtures.NOTES).forEach(function(k) {
			var t = fixtures.NOTES[k], m = build(t);
			m.units.forEach(function(u) {
				[1, -1].forEach(function(dir) {
					var r = fmt.move(t, m, u.id, dir);
					if(!r) { return; }
					moved++;
					var m2 = build(r.text);
					expect(m2.units.length).withContext(k + " " + u.id).toBe(m.units.length);
					function ks(mm) { return mm.units.map(function(x) { return x.kind + ":" + x.level; }).sort(); }
					expect(ks(m2)).toEqual(ks(m));
					var nid = -1;
					m2.units.forEach(function(x) { if(x.start === r.select && x.kind === u.kind) { nid = x.id; } });
					expect(nid).not.toBe(-1);
					var sibs = u.parent === -1 ? m.roots : m.units[u.parent].children,
						o = m.units[sibs[sibs.indexOf(u.id) + dir]],
						lo = dir < 0 ? o.start : u.start, hi = dir < 0 ? u.subtreeEnd : o.subtreeEnd;
					fixtures.assertOnlyRangesChanged(t, r.text, [[lo, hi]], expect);
					expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, u.id, "move", r.text)).withContext(k + " " + u.id + " " + dir).toBe(true);
					var back = fmt.move(r.text, m2, nid, -dir);
					// Touching blocks get a blank-line separator: the way back keeps it, so it only gives back the same units
					var a = dir < 0 ? o : u, b = dir < 0 ? u : o;
					var blank = /\n[ \t]*\r?\n/, gap = /^\s*/.exec(t.substring(b.subtreeEnd))[0];
					if(u.kind !== "item" && u.kind !== "heading" && (!blank.test(t.substring(a.subtreeEnd, b.start)) ||
						(b.subtreeEnd + gap.length < t.length && !blank.test(gap)))) {
						expect(back && ks(build(back.text))).withContext(k + " " + u.id + " " + dir).toEqual(ks(m));
					} else {
						expect(back && back.text).withContext(k + " " + u.id + " " + dir).toBe(t);
					}
				});
			});
		});
		expect(moved).toBeGreaterThan(10);
	});
});

type: application/javascript

Pins the TiddlyWiki parser positions (start/end) the outline model relies on.

\*/
"use strict";

describe("outline parser pins", function() {

	function parse(src) {
		return $tw.wiki.parseText("text/vnd.tiddlywiki", src).tree;
	}

	it("list items: ranges exclude nested items", function() {
		var ul = parse("* a\n** b\n* c")[0];
		expect(ul.tag).toBe("ul");
		expect(ul.start).toBe(0);
		var li1 = ul.children[0];
		expect(li1.tag).toBe("li");
		expect(li1.start).toBe(0);
		expect(li1.end).toBe(3);
		var nested = li1.children[1].children[0];
		expect(nested.tag).toBe("li");
		expect(nested.start).toBe(4);
		expect(nested.end).toBe(8);
		var li2 = ul.children[1];
		expect(li2.start).toBe(9);
		expect(li2.end).toBe(12);
	});

	it("heading and paragraph", function() {
		var tree = parse("! H\n\npara");
		expect(tree[0].tag).toBe("h1");
		expect(tree[0].start).toBe(0);
		expect(tree[0].end).toBe(3);
		expect(tree[0].rule).toBe("heading");
		expect(tree[1].tag).toBe("p");
		expect(tree[1].start).toBe(5);
		expect(tree[1].end).toBe(9);
		expect(tree[1].rule).toBe("parseblock");
	});

	// Real shape (differs from the plan): the positioned block node is a "tiddler" widget
	// (rule transcludeblock) whose end includes the newline; the inner "transclude"
	// child carries no start/end. The target is in attributes.tiddler.value.
	it("block transclusion", function() {
		var node = parse("{{X}}\n")[0];
		expect(node.type).toBe("tiddler");
		expect(node.rule).toBe("transcludeblock");
		expect(node.start).toBe(0);
		expect(node.end).toBe(6);
		expect(node.attributes.tiddler.value).toBe("X");
		expect(node.children[0].type).toBe("transclude");
		expect(node.children[0].attributes.$tiddler.value).toBe("X");
	});

	it("pragma wraps the following blocks", function() {
		var tree = parse("\\define m() x\n* a");
		expect(tree[0].type).toBe("set");
		var li = tree[0].children[0].children[0];
		expect(li.tag).toBe("li");
		expect(li.start).toBe(14);
	});

	it("code block", function() {
		var node = parse("```js\nx\n```")[0];
		expect(node.type).toBe("codeblock");
		expect(node.start).toBe(0);
		expect(node.end).toBe(11); // plan said 12; the source is 11 chars
	});

	it("table", function() {
		var node = parse("|a|b|\n")[0];
		expect(node.tag).toBe("table");
		expect(node.start).toBe(0);
	});

	it("block-mode html container", function() {
		var div = parse("<div>\n\n* a\n\n</div>")[0];
		expect(div.tag).toBe("div");
		expect(div.isBlock).toBe(true);

"use strict";

var tu = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/text-utils.js");

describe("outline text-utils", function() {

	it("eol detects CRLF, LF and defaults to LF", function() {
		expect(tu.eol("a\r\nb\n")).toBe("\r\n");
		expect(tu.eol("a\nb\r\n")).toBe("\n");
		expect(tu.eol("abc")).toBe("\n");
	});

	it("splice replaces and round-trips", function() {
		var text = "hello world";
		expect(tu.splice(text, 6, 11, "there")).toBe("hello there");
		expect(tu.splice(text, 5, 5, "!")).toBe("hello! world");
		var out = tu.splice(text, 0, 5, "bye");
		expect(tu.splice(out, 0, 3, "hello")).toBe(text);
	});

	it("lineStart finds the start of the line", function() {
		var text = "ab\ncd\r\nef";
		expect(tu.lineStart(text, 0)).toBe(0);
		expect(tu.lineStart(text, 2)).toBe(0);
		expect(tu.lineStart(text, 4)).toBe(3);
		expect(tu.lineStart(text, 8)).toBe(7);
		expect(tu.lineStart("\nabc", 0)).toBe(0);
		expect(tu.lineStart("ab\ncd", 2)).toBe(0);
		expect(tu.lineStart("ab\ncd", 5)).toBe(3);
		expect(tu.lineStart("ab\n", 3)).toBe(3);
	});

	it("relocate returns the index of a unique occurrence", function() {
		expect(tu.relocate("xx* a\nyy", "* a")).toBe(2);
	});

	it("relocate returns -1 for zero and two occurrences", function() {
		expect(tu.relocate("abc", "zz")).toBe(-1);
		expect(tu.relocate("* a\n* a", "* a")).toBe(-1);
		expect(tu.relocate("abc", "")).toBe(-1);
	});
});

Tests for the $outline widget (rendering, unit -> DOM mapping, stamps, markers) and the body routing filter.

"use strict";

var model = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js"),
	fixtures = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/fixtures.js");

describe("outline widget", function() {

	var BODY_FILTER = "$:/plugins/rimir/outline/ui/body-filter",
		BODY = "$:/plugins/rimir/outline/ui/body";

	function makeWiki(tiddlers) {
		var wiki = new $tw.Wiki();
		wiki.addTiddlers(tiddlers || []);
		wiki.addIndexersToWiki();
		return wiki;
	}

	function render(wiki, text) {
		var parser = wiki.parseText("text/vnd.tiddlywiki", text, {parseAsInline: false}),
			root = wiki.makeWidget(parser, {document: $tw.fakeDocument}),
			container = $tw.fakeDocument.createElement("div");
		root.render(container, null);
		return {root: root, container: container};
	}

	function renderOutline(wiki, title) {
		var r = render(wiki, "<$outline tiddler=\"" + title + "\"><$transclude $tiddler=\"" + title + "\" $mode=\"block\"/></$outline>");
		r.widget = findWidget(r.root, "outline");
		return r;
	}

	function findWidget(widget, type) {
		if(widget.parseTreeNode && widget.parseTreeNode.type === type) {
			return widget;
		}
		for(var i = 0; i < (widget.children || []).length; i++) {
			var found = findWidget(widget.children[i], type);
			if(found) {
				return found;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	// All element nodes below `node`, depth first
	function elements(node, out) {
		out = out || [];
		(node.children || []).forEach(function(child) {
			if(child.nodeType === 1) {
				out.push(child);
				elements(child, out);
			}
		});
		return out;
	}

	function stamped(container) {
		return elements(container).filter(function(el) {
			return el.attributes["data-ol-id"] !== undefined;
		});
	}

	function outlineRoot(container) {
		return elements(container).filter(function(el) {
			return (el.attributes["class"] || "").split(" ").indexOf("rr-ol") !== -1;
		})[0];
	}

	function stripOutline(html) {
		return html
			.replace(/<span class="rr-ol-tmark"[^>]*>.*?<\/span>/g, "")
			.replace(/ data-ol-[a-z]+="[^"]*"/g, "")
			.replace(/ tabindex="0"/g, "");
	}

	it("stamps units", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([
			{title: "T", text: "! H\n\n* a\n** b\n\n{{X}}"},
			{title: "X", text: "* inner"}
		]);
		var r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"),
			els = stamped(r.container),
			kinds = els.map(function(el) { return el.getAttribute("data-ol-kind") + ":" + el.tag; });
		expect(kinds).toEqual(["heading:h1", "list:ul", "item:li", "item:li", "transclusion:ul"]);
		// No element from X's own text is stamped as an item
		els.forEach(function(el) {
			if(el.getAttribute("data-ol-kind") === "item") {
				expect(el.textContent.indexOf("inner")).toBe(-1);
			}
		});
		var m = r.widget.model;
		expect(r.widget.units.length).toBe(m.units.length);
		r.widget.units.forEach(function(entry, i) {
			expect(entry.unit).toBe(m.units[i]);
			expect(entry.domNodes.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
			entry.domNodes.forEach(function(el) {
				expect(el.getAttribute("data-ol-id")).toBe(String(i));
				expect(el.getAttribute("data-ol-start")).toBe(String(entry.unit.start));
			});
		});
		var trans = r.widget.units[4];
		expect(trans.unit.kind).toBe("transclusion");
		var marks = elements(trans.domNodes[0]).filter(function(el) {
			return el.attributes["class"] === "rr-ol-tmark";
		});
		expect(marks.length).toBe(1);
		expect(marks[0].attributes.title).toBe("X");
		// A <span> directly in a <ul> is invalid HTML: the marker goes into the first item
		expect(marks[0].parentNode.tag).toBe("li");
		expect(marks[0].parentNode.parentNode).toBe(trans.domNodes[0]);
		expect(outlineRoot(r.container).getAttribute("tabindex")).toBe("0");
	});

	it("same html as normal", function() {
		Object.keys(fixtures.NOTES).forEach(function(name) {
			var wiki = makeWiki([
				{title: "T", text: fixtures.NOTES[name]},
				{title: "Some Tiddler", text: "* from some tiddler\n\npara"},
				{title: "Task 1", tags: "Task"}
			]);
			var plain = render(wiki, "<$transclude $tiddler=\"T\" $mode=\"block\"/>\n"),
				outlined = renderOutline(wiki, "T");
			expect(name + ":" + stripOutline(outlineRoot(outlined.container).innerHTML))
				.toBe(name + ":" + plain.container.innerHTML);
		});
	});

	it("maps every corpus unit to DOM nodes", function() {
		Object.keys(fixtures.NOTES).forEach(function(name) {
			var wiki = makeWiki([
				{title: "T", text: fixtures.NOTES[name]},
				{title: "Some Tiddler", text: "* from some tiddler\n\npara"},
				{title: "Task 1", tags: "Task"}
			]);
			var r = renderOutline(wiki, "T");
			expect(r.widget.units.length).toBe(r.widget.model.units.length);
			r.widget.units.forEach(function(entry) {
				var u = entry.unit;
				if(u.kind === "transclusion" || u.kind === "widget") {
					return; // may render no element (missing template, undefined macro, text-only output)
				}
				expect(name + ":" + u.kind + ":" + u.start + ":" + (entry.domNodes.length > 0))
					.toBe(name + ":" + u.kind + ":" + u.start + ":" + true);
			});
		});
	});

	it("stamps blocks, containers and widgets in the blocks note", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([
			{title: "T", text: fixtures.NOTES.blocks + "\n@@.x\nstyled\n@@\n\n$$$text/plain\nplain\n$$$\n"},
			{title: "Some Tiddler", text: "para"},
			{title: "Some Template", text: "<div>tpl</div>"},
			{title: "Task 1", tags: "Task"}
		]);
		var r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"),
			kinds = r.widget.units.map(function(e) {
				return e.unit.kind + ":" + e.domNodes.map(function(n) { return n.tag; }).join(",");
			});
		// @@ styled block and $$$ typed block are DOM-less widgets, mapped to their top-level elements
		expect(kinds).toEqual([
			"heading:h1",
			"block:pre",
			"block:table",
			"transclusion:p",
			"transclusion:p",
			"widget:",
			"widget:",
			"block:p",
			"block:p",
			"block:pre"
		]);
		// Each unit has DOM nodes except the undefined macro call and the $list whose template renders text only
		r.widget.units.forEach(function(e) {
			if(e.unit.kind !== "widget") {
				expect(e.unit.kind + ":" + e.unit.start + ":" + (e.domNodes.length > 0)).toBe(e.unit.kind + ":" + e.unit.start + ":true");
			}
		});
	});

	it("maps a skipped-level item to its real li, not the synthetic one", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: fixtures.NOTES.mixedLevels}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"),
			m = r.widget.model,
			c = r.widget.units.filter(function(e) {
				return e.unit.kind === "item" && m.text.substring(e.unit.start, e.unit.end) === "*** c";
			})[0];
		expect(c.domNodes.length).toBe(1);
		expect(c.domNodes[0].children[0].nodeType).toBe(3);
		expect(c.domNodes[0].textContent).toBe("c");
		// Every item maps to an li that is stamped with its own id only once
		var ids = stamped(r.container).map(function(el) { return el.attributes["data-ol-id"]; });
		expect(ids.length).toBe($tw.utils.pushTop([], ids).length);
	});

	it("does not descend into a same-tiddler transclusion of a field (its positions refer to the field text)", function() {
		var host = "* a <$transclude $tiddler=\"T\" $field=\"caption\" $mode=\"block\"/>\n* b",
			k = host.indexOf("* b"),
			caption = new Array(k - 1).join("x") + "\n\n* c",
			wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: host, caption: caption}]),
			r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"),
			m = r.widget.model;
		expect(caption.indexOf("* c")).toBe(k);
		var b = r.widget.units.filter(function(e) { return m.text.substring(e.unit.start, e.unit.end) === "* b"; })[0];
		expect(b.domNodes.length).toBe(1);
		expect(b.domNodes[0].textContent).toBe("b");
	});

	it("renders empty tiddler", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: ""}]);
		var r;
		expect(function() { r = renderOutline(wiki, "T"); }).not.toThrow();
		expect(r.widget.units.length).toBe(0);
		var wiki2 = makeWiki([{title: "P", text: fixtures.NOTES.pragmaOnly}]),
			r2 = renderOutline(wiki2, "P");
		expect(r2.widget.units.length).toBe(0);
		var r3 = renderOutline(makeWiki([]), "Missing");
		expect(r3.widget.units.length).toBe(0);
	});

	it("refresh remaps", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([{title: "T", text: "* a\n* b"}]);
		var r = renderOutline(wiki, "T");
		expect(r.widget.units.length).toBe(3);
		wiki.addTiddler({title: "T", text: "! New\n\n* x\n** y\n** z\n\nend"});
		r.root.refresh({"T": {modified: true}});
		var m = model.buildModel(wiki, wiki.getTiddlerText("T"), "T");
		expect(r.widget.model.text).toBe(m.text);
		expect(r.widget.units.map(function(e) { return e.unit.kind + ":" + e.unit.start; }))
			.toEqual(m.units.map(function(u) { return u.kind + ":" + u.start; }));
		var els = stamped(r.container);
		expect(els.map(function(el) { return el.getAttribute("data-ol-kind"); }))
			.toEqual(["heading", "list", "item", "item", "item", "block"]);
	});

	it("refresh re-adds a transclusion marker once", function() {
		var wiki = makeWiki([
			{title: "T", text: "{{X}}\n\npara"},
			{title: "X", text: "x one"}
		]);
		var r = renderOutline(wiki, "T");

		r.root.refresh({"Other": {modified: true}});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: "X", text: "x two"});
		r.root.refresh({"X": {modified: true}});
		var marks = elements(r.container).filter(function(el) {

		it("leaves system, code-body and hide-body tiddlers alone", function() {
			var wiki = cascadeWiki([
				{title: "$:/S", text: "x"},

type: application/javascript

Small text helpers for outline edits: line endings, splicing, line starts and relocation.

\*/
"use strict";

// First line ending found in text; "\n" when there is none
exports.eol = function(text) {
	var m = /\r\n|\n/.exec(text);
	return m && m[0] === "\r\n" ? "\r\n" : "\n";
};

exports.splice = function(text, start, end, insert) {
	return text.substring(0, start) + insert + text.substring(end);
};

// Index of the first character of the line containing pos
exports.lineStart = function(text, pos) {
	if(pos <= 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	return text.lastIndexOf("\n", pos - 1) + 1;
};

// Index of oldSlice in newText if it occurs exactly once, else -1
